title: Dealer Account Manager
description:
About AIM Intelligent Machines

AIM Intelligent Machines is pioneering the future of heavy equipment automation. Our technology enables a single operator to monitor and control multiple machines simultaneously—dramatically improving productivity, reducing labor costs, and reshaping what's possible in construction, mining, and industrial operations.

Through cutting-edge AI, computer vision, and robotics, AIM is solving critical challenges in equipment autonomy and remote operations. We're building systems that augment human capability—allowing people to do more with less, safely and efficiently.

We are growing quickly and looking for experienced, motivated Account Managers to accelerate adoption of our solutions by building strong partnerships and cultivating strategic customer relationships.

 

Position Summary

As Dealer Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in scaling AIM’s groundbreaking heavy equipment automation platform. You’ll be responsible for growing revenue through both channel partners and direct key accounts, with a clear focus on companies looking to deploy machine automation that allows one operator to manage fleets of equipment.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams—including sales leadership, product, and engineering—to help customers modernize their operations and gain a competitive edge through AIM’s autonomous systems.

title: Team Lead AI Engineering (f/m/d)
description:
We're digitizing the construction industry – are you in?

At VESTIGAS, you build the digital backbone of the construction supply chain. We turn purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices into a digital, legally compliant platform used in everyday operations by construction companies and suppliers. You’ll work on a product with real market traction in the DACH mid-market, ship iteratively, and take ownership of solutions that must work in the field—not just in theory.


Your Role

As Team Lead – AI Engineering, you'll own the AI infrastructure and capabilities that power our supply chain platform end to end – from pipeline design to production deployment. You bring prior leadership experience and are ready to lead a team of AI engineers: setting technical direction, growing your team's capabilities, and making sure the team consistently delivers reliable, scalable AI systems.

The Technical ChallengeYour team will tackle problems like extracting structured data reliably from many different documents, building uncertainty estimation so the system knows when to flag a document for human review instead of silently guessing, and automatically reconciling purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices against each other – all within legal and compliance requirements that leave no room for "close enough." This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents nobody has seen before – and you'll set the technical direction for how the team navigates that trade-off, deciding where to push automation further and where human review still matters.


Your Mission

title: Lab Operations Manager
description:
About Substrate

Substrate is the critical infrastructure layer between AI and biology. AI for biology has a data problem, not a compute problem: biological foundation models can predict but cannot experiment, and the large-scale, high-quality data they need does not exist. We are building the lab that generates it, with quality and provenance built in. We are not a CRO and we are not a cloud lab.

The company was founded by Mostafa ElSayed, co-founder and CEO; Oli Hoy, who leads the lab buildout and operations; Alexey Morgunov, who leads science and intelligence software; and Anna Huyghues-Despointes, who leads partnerships and go-to-market.

The role

You will run the day-to-day operations of our lab in London, and be the person the scientists come to when something is missing, broken, late or lost. The day-one work is what you would expect: consumables and stock, goods in and cold chain, equipment servicing and calibration, suppliers and purchasing, waste streams and safety records.

Three parts go beyond a standard lab operations job. The first is provenance. Every experiment we sell carries a record of what went into it, down to the lot of the consumable used and the conditions material was held in. If a lot number is not captured, the data point is worth less, and that record runs through you.

The second is that the systems are not written yet. Inventory, goods in, asset registers and ordering exist in no form that will survive the next year. You define what the lab has to capture and work with the science and software teams to make sure it does.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Ads Bidding
description:
Staff Machine Learning Engineer – Ads Bidding

The Team

The Ads ML team builds and maintains the machine learning models powering Deliveroo's advertising product — connecting consumers with relevant ads and helping merchants, grocers, and FMCG brands grow through the platform. The UK team is ~11 MLEs across ads and promotions, and collaborates closely with the US team (meetings capped at 4pm UK to protect reasonable hours).

The Problem

Deliveroo is migrating ads from cost-per-click (CPC) to cost-per-order (CPO) — merchants pay when an ad drives an order, not when it's clicked. This is a genuinely open, cutting-edge problem: very few companies have solved it, and there's no established playbook to follow. The exact approach is under active discussion and you'd be central to driving it.

You will:

  • Own the design and execution of the CPC-to-CPO migration, including the core open question of whether the system stays CPO-facing externally while optimising CPC behind the scenes, or some hybrid of the two

  • Build and improve the bidding surface: goal-based automated bidding, Target CPO, optimised CPC, and Target ROAS

  • Own yield management tied to ROS targeting

  • Partner daily with the DoorDash US team to align on approach across markets

  • Set technical direction for the domain

Requirements

  • Expertise in ad economics, marketplace bidding, or auction theory

title: Senior Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer
description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Senior Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer you will own the methodology, planning, and execution of mixed-signal verification for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago's Systems-on-Chip, working across analog, RTL, architecture, and firmware teams to ensure correct integration and drive verification to sign-off.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience in ASIC or SoC verification.

  • Experience verifying mixed-signal blocks or digital-to-analog and analog-to-digital interfaces.

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. title: Visiting Founders Associate (Engineering)
description:
About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

 

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $10M ARR, with a 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.

About the role

We're looking for a Visiting Founders Associate to join our engineering team in Berlin. You'll be the operational backbone of the team, running the processes, projects, and internal work that keep everything moving, so our engineers can stay focused on building.

The main piece of the role is our compliance work, which you'll coordinate and execute end to end. Around that sits everything else a fast-growing engineering team needs: internal IT, new tooling, team rituals, onboarding, and being the person the rest of the company comes to when they need something technical explained or unblocked. What you’ll do

title: Technical Lead, Laser Amplification (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

As Technical Lead, Laser Amplification, you will own the end-to-end technical delivery of the laser amplification subsystem. The amplification chain is the primary energy-scaling element of the laser system, so this role is central to translating ICF system requirements into an integrated, high-performing function.

You will define the subsystem architecture, establish the technical roadmap, lead design and test activities, manage interfaces and risks, and develop the team and capabilities needed to take the amplification chain from concept through hardware delivery and integration.


What you’ll do

  • Define and own the technical architecture for Main Amplifier systems from concept through design freeze, including topology, gain media, pump geometry, thermal management, ASE control, and interface specifications.

  • Build and maintain the technical roadmap for Light Amplification, aligning development sequence, capability gaps, technology maturity, and program milestones.

  • Lead the design, build, characterization, and integration of the amplification chain.

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.

Nous recherchons un stagiaire de fin d’études pour accompagner le renforcement de l’équipe Real Estate Services / Immobilier.

title: Post-doctorat en interprétabilité mécaniste et diversité des représentations
description:
Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Le poste est basé à Brest, au sein de l'équipe BRAIN (BRoader Artificial INtelligence) du Lab-STICC (UMR CNRS 6285). L'équipe travaille sur les fondements de l'apprentissage automatique (représentations, apprentissage frugal, modèles de fondation, traitement du signal) et sur leurs applications, en particulier en santé. Elle a récemment développé REVE, un modèle de fondation pour l'électroencéphalographie pré-entraîné sur plus de 25 000 sujets (NeurIPS 2025), et s’intéresse aux modèles de langage à diffusion discrète et sur l'interprétabilité mécaniste.

Le projet ENDIVE étudie ce que la diversité peut apporter à l'apprentissage automatique lorsque le budget porte sur le nombre d'exemples annotés plutôt que sur la puissance de calcul. Dans ce régime, ce qu'apporte un nouvel exemple ne dépend plus seulement de sa qualité propre, mais de ce qui le distingue de ceux déjà vus. Le point d'entrée technique du projet est l'échantillonnage à garanties de diversité, et en particulier les processus ponctuels déterminantaux (DPP), dont la matrice de noyau encode à la fois la pertinence des points et leur similarité.

title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we´re looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.

Our mission

Bounti is building the AI-native infrastructure layer for frontline teams, spanning training, audits, and autonomous operations. We partner with multi-location operators in frontline industries such as hospitality.

What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.

  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production

title: Senior Industrialisation Engineer (m/f/d) - EFT Mobility AG
description:
Join EFT Mobility at a pivotal time as we revolutionize the future of electric transport, focusing on cutting-edge Electric Powertrain (EFT) solutions for high-reliability applications, including UAV power systems. We are a fast-growing, dynamic company where every engineer plays a direct, hands-on role in bringing our innovative, safety-critical products to life. If you thrive on ensuring product quality and solving complex, real-world problems, we want you on our team.

We are seeking a highly skilled, execution-driven and hands-on Senior Industrialisation Engineer to bridge the gap between R&D and mass manufacturing for our battery packs and charger product lines.

In this role, your primary focus will be the electro-mechanical process steps and optimizations required to transform a functional prototype into a robust, high-yield, and highly scalable series product. You will take ownership of the product lifecycle immediately following the initial prototype build phase. Collaborating closely with our external Contract Manufacturers (CMs), you will co-architect the manufacturing lines, advise on critical assembly fixtures, and pave the way for a production ramp-up from pre-series batches into stable mass production.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Review designs directly following R&D prototype runs to actively catch and eliminate mechanical tolerance stack-ups and assembly risks before tooling begins.

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
description:
Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.

In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.

The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:

  • Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.

  • Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.

penetration sits under 15%, against roughly 70% in the US. The labour
productivity gap runs about 30%. Millions of skilled people spend their evenings
on paperwork instead of the craft they trained for — in the industry that has to
deliver the energy transition.

last.

smalt replaces the back office entirely rather than selling Meister another tool

Was dieser Job ist, steht unten. Was er nicht ist, auch.

In dieser vielseitigen Doppelrolle verbindest du messerscharfe Zahlenkompetenz mit einem echten Gespür für Datenarchitektur und Reporting-Infrastruktur. Du baust nicht nur ein stabiles Controlling auf, sondern gestaltest parallel die technische Grundlage, auf der unser gesamtes Unternehmen datenbasierte Entscheidungen trifft. description: Customer Success [Coach Terminator]       Sobre nosotros y nuestra cultura [The Walcu Way]:   Somos una start-up tecnológica que ofrece un CRM (herramienta de gestión comercial) en la nube (SaaS) a concesionarios. En 8 años ya somos unos 50 empleados y facturamos €8M anuales en ventas de software a empresas del automóvil. Nos hemos convertido en líderes del mercado español y ya tenemos presencia en otros países de Europa y Latinoamérica.      Sobre ti:   No seremos nosotros quienes digamos cómo eres tú, salvo en este caso, que sí lo haremos. 🙂   Tú tienes experiencia o quieres desarrollarte en la gestión de clientes y entorno SaaS.  Tienes una escritura excelente y unas habilidades comunicativas poderosas –¿lleva coma el vocativo?–, y te sientes muy cómodo/a trabajando en un ambiente eléctrico y de alto rendimiento..  Eres una persona con una alta inteligencia emocional y con la capacidad de entender y empatizar con las necesidades de otros.  Eres una persona curiosa con criterio para detectar mejoras en la experiencia del usuario, te manejas bien con la tecnología, tienes iniciativa y proactividad. Esto es importante para encajar bien con nuestra cultura, ya que somos doers.  Te llena de energía hacer que tus clientes consigan hacer realidad sus proyectos.  Quieres ser la persona que ayuda a nuestros clientes a sacar el máximo partido de nuestro software.       ¿Cómo será tu día a día como Customer Coach?   Sí, hemos retirado el término Customer Success y lo hemos rebrandeado como Customer Coach porque el verdadero éxito no consiste en ayudar a los clientes a hacer el trabajo. Se trata de ayudarles a aprender a hacer el trabajo. No hacemos el trabajo para los clientes.  Enseñamos a los clientes a hacer el trabajo por sí mismos.      Responsabilidades principales:    Llevarás cuentas del mercado Español.  Liderarás la cuenta una vez finalizado el onboarding, siendo la persona de referencia del cliente en su día a día.  Entrenarás y acompañarás al cliente para que saque el máximo partido a Walcu y lo integre en su operativa real.  Entenderás su negocio, sus objetivos y sus retos para convertir la herramienta en impacto tangible.  Identificarás oportunidades de evolución en la cuenta, proponiendo ampliaciones que generen impacto real. Para nosotros el éxito no es vender más licencias, sino que el cliente sienta Walcu como su propio CRM.  Monitorizarás la salud de la relación (uso, engagement, riesgo de churn) y actuarás antes de que haya problemas.  Trasladarás al equipo de Producto feedback accionable y defenderás la voz del cliente dentro de Walcu.       Condiciones laborales:    Contrato a jornada completa –40 horas semanales–.  Contrato indefinido –queremos a alguien para siempre ❤–.  Palomitas de mantequilla y happydent de menta ilimitados.  Y alucina vecina:ni UNO ni DOS sino TRES microondas.  Opción de trabajar 2 días a la semana en remoto a partir del cuarto mes –presencial 100% durante los primeros 4 meses para empaparse de la cultura

title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö, arjen talous, OP Etelä-Pirkanmaa
description: Tule meille kollegaksi    Oletko finanssialan ammattilainen ja haluat päästä hyödyntämään asiantuntijuuttasi pankkimme keskeisessä roolissa? Sytytkö innostavasta johtamisesta ja haluatko päästä kehittämään asiakaskokemusta tiimiäsi valmentaen? Haluatko työskennellä pankissa, jonka toiminnan keskiössä on asiakaslähtöisyys?   Haemme nyt arjen talouden tiimiimme asiakkuuspäällikköä vahvistamaan joukkoamme  OP Etelä-Pirkanmaalle .   Tehtävästä   Tässä tehtävässä toimit lähiesihenkilönä noin 14 henkilön arjen talouden tiimille (päivittäispalvelut sekä verkko- ja puhelinpalvelu). Olet tärkeässä roolissa johtamassa henkilöstön työhyvinvointia sekä erinomaista työntekijäkokemusta. Johdat pankin päivittäis- ja verkkopalveluita ja kehität vastuualuettasi proaktiivisesti, valmennat tiimiäsi asiakaskohtaamisissa ja luot edellytyksiä tiimiläistesi ammatilliselle kasvulle. Varmistat samalla, että tiimin osaaminen on sääntelyn mukaista ja työ tuloksellista. Oleellinen osa työtäsi on myynnin valmentaminen ja arjen työjärjestelyt. Kehität vastuualueesi toimintaa rohkeasti. Mahdollistat tiimillesi itseohjautuvan työskentelytavan ja olet varmistamassa, että asiakaspalvelu- ja toimintaprosessit luovat edellytykset erinomaiselle asiakaskokemukselle. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myös pankkimme muiden esihenkilöiden kanssa ja osallistut tarvittaessa tiimin töihin.  Pääasiallinen työpisteesi voisi sijoittua joko Akaan tai Valkeakosken konttorille. Tehtävä edellyttää kuitenkin liikkumista kaikilla konttoreillamme. Teemme työtä hybridimallilla, lähi- ja etätyötä yhdistellen. Tiimisi työskentelee eri konttoreissamme.   Millaista osaamista etsimme?   Edellytämme vankkaa kokemusta finanssialalta pankkiliiketoiminnasta ja erityisesti tuntemusta päivittäispankkipalveluista ja verkko- ja puhelinpalvelusta. Katsomme eduksesi aiemman esihenkilökokemuksen tai muun valmennusosaamisen. Koulutustaustasi voi olla esimerkiksi kaupallinen tai muuten tehtävään soveltuva.  Suhtaudut muutokseen ja kehittymiseen myönteisesti ja uudistuksien jalkauttaminen sekä eteenpäin vieminen on sinulle luontevaa. Koet olevasi myyntihenkinen. Omaat hyvät organisointitaidot ja pystyt sopeutumaan nopeastikin muuttuviin tilanteisiin. Olet kannustava ja haluat auttaa tiimisi jäseniä kehittymään. Otat vastuun omasta kentästäsi ja päätöksenteko sujuu sinulta luontevasti. Menestyäksesi tässä tehtävässä tarvitset hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja viestintätyylisi on vakuuttava ja vaikuttava.   Me tarjoamme   OP Etelä-Pirkanmaa sijaitsee elinvoimaisella toimialueella Suomen kasvukäytävällä. Konttorimme sijaitsevat Akaassa, Valkeakoskella, Punkalaitumella ja Urjalassa. Konserniimme kuuluu lisäksi OP Koti Etelä-Pirkanmaa Oy LKV.  Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työn kehitysmyönteisessä organisaatiossa sekä mahdollisuuden vahvistaa omaa asiantuntijuuttasi finanssialalla. Meillä vallitsee avoin, rento ja keskusteleva ilmapiiri, jossa jokainen saa olla oma itsensä ja kehittyä. Sinua odottaa porukka, johon on helppo solahtaa

title: Apulaismyymäläpäällikkö Helsingin Iso Roobertinkadun myymäläämme
description: Etsimme Normal-myymäläämme iloisen ja energisen asenteen omaavaa apulaismyymäläpäällikköä!   Apulaismyymäläpäällikkönä olet avainasemassa luomassa asiakkaille uniikkia osto- ja asiakaskokemusta. Toimit myymäläpäällikön kanssa tiiminä, motivoiden ja kehittäen työntekijöitä avoimessa ja iloisessa ympäristössä. Yhdessä varmistatte, että myymälä toimii tehokkaasti ja saavuttaa myyntitavoitteet. Myymälän visuaalinen ilme ja tiimin johtaminen ovat intohimosi. Pääset perehtymään tehtävääsi huippuosaajien kanssa, jonka tavoitteena on antaa sinulle alkustartti ammatilliseen ja henkilökohtaiseen kasvuun ja kehittymiseen. Kenties mielenkiintosi on toimia jonakin päivänä NORMAL-ketjun myymäläpäällikkönä!  NORMAL on nuori dynaaminen yritys, joka on muutaman vuoden aikana avannut satoja myymälöitä ympäri Euroopan. Myös Suomessa kasvumme jatkuu edelleen.  Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme pysyvästi matalat hinnat ja useita tuhansia ”normaaleja” tuotteita mm. kemikalio-, kosmetiikka- ja kotitaloustuotteiden saralla, unohtamatta jännittäviä uutuuksia joka viikko useissa eri tuotekategorioissa. NORMAL on yritys, jossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia ja meillä on yhteiset menestymis- ja tulostavoitteet - ja samalla pidämme hauskaa yhdessä.   Mitä Toivomme Sinulta     olet kunnianhimoinen ja kerännyt kokemusta esihenkilönä toimimisesta - tuemme sinua roolissasi  asiakaspalvelu on intohimosi – asiakas on aina tärkein  olet motivoitunut, määrätietoinen ja väsymätön tiiminjohtaja – innostat ja motivoit omalla esimerkilläsi  paineensietokykyä – nopeatempoinen työ vie sinut mennessään ja uppoudut siihen mielelläsi  myymälän johtaminen ja kauppiashenkinen toiminen saa sinun syttymään – lukujen seuraaminen tukee myyntiä  omaat itsenäiset työskentelytaidot, mutta ymmärrät tiimin voiman – yhdessä on hauskempaa  sinulla on visuaalista silmää – esillepanojen teko best!  työt sijoittuvat niin aamu-, ilta- kuin välivuoroihinkin – monipuoliset työajat  kommunikoit vaivattomasti suomeksi ja asiakkaiden palvelu englanniksi onnistuu myös - but of course!  myymäläpäällikön ollessa poissa hyppäät puikkoihin empimättä ja varmistat myymäläntoiminnan     Mikäli etsit inspiroivaa, hauskaa ja menevää työpaikkaa, hae ihmeessä meille ja tule osaksi mahtavaa porukkaamme!  Maksamme palkkaa TES:in mukaisesti.   Oletko se sinä?   Odotamme innolla hakemustasi ja arvostamme myös videon muodossa tulevaa esittelyä! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo ennen hakuajan umpeutumista, ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Manager Customer Services & Network Development (m/w/d)

■業務内容： 確定拠出年金（DC）に関わる以下の業務を担っていただきます。 将来的には、他部門の業務にも携わり、確定拠出年金（DC）事業において幅広くご活躍いただける人材を募集します。  ・確定拠出年金（DC）のコールセンターの運営管理、改善業務と新サービスの企画立案 ・オペレーターの管理（シフト管理等）、育成に関するマネジメント全般。 ・確定拠出年金（DC）加入者等のお客さまからの問い合せ対応、およびメンバー指導、エスカレーション対応  ■当社の強み： ◎SOMPOグループの損害保険ジャパン（株）100％出資の事業基盤 ◎確定拠出年金事業においてプラン導入～運営管理までワンストップでサービス提供する専門会社 ◎「DCで豊かな未来をともに」をパーパスに掲げ、お客さまの人生100年時代の資産形成をサポート  ■当社について： 当社は、確定拠出年金(DC)に関する様々なサービスを提供する、日本でも数少ないDC専門会社です。 少子高齢化の進展、公的年金財政が厳しさを増す中、わが国においてもグローバルな潮流と同様、自助の仕組みであるDCが主流となってまいりました。 様々な税制優遇措置に加え、企業にとっては退職給付債務の対象外となることから、福利厚生制度の充実・人材確保、リスク軽減等の観点からも普及・定着が加速しています。 当社は米国401k制度を参考に、企業への制度導入サポートから運用商品の情報提供、口座管理に至るまで、DCに関するサービスをすべて1社で提供できる、国内でほとんど例のないワンストップサービスを実現しており、多くの企業に採用いただいており、企業型DCの承認規約数は業界トップです。 特に英語によるサービスを組織的・総合的に提供できることを強みとしており、外資系企業とのお取引数は業界トップクラスとなっています。また、近年加入者が急増している個人型DC(iDeCo)に関しても包括的なサービスを提供しています。そして、DCをより身近にご利用いただくため、AI・ロボアドバイザーを搭載した情報提供サービスを業界に先駆け提供するなど、お客さまに寄り添った高品質な資産形成サービスにも注力しています。 title: Key Account Manager, Stock Group A/S
location: Vejle Municipality, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: Hansen Toft søger en Key Account Manager på vegne af Stock Group        Omlægning af traditionel field sales til mere struktureret og analytisk salgsindsats    Stock Group er i gang med en strategisk omlægning af salgsorganisationen med det formål at drive salget mere effektivt, struktureret og analytisk – uden at gå på kompromis med den iværksætterånd, det købmandskab og det tempo, der kendetegner virksomheden.     Du får det fulde kommercielle ansvar for din egen kundeportefølje bestående af enkeltbutikker i supermarkedskæderne, og dette med udgangspunkt fra hovedkontoret i Vejle.      Skærpet fokus på værdiskabelse og sparring frem for kortsigtet ordresalg   Din primære opgave bliver at videreudvikle og vedligeholde de stærke, langsigtede kunderelationer med skærpet fokus på at være sparrende og værdiskabende frem for at tænke i kortsigtet ordresalg. Hovedfokus bliver at skabe vækst hos eksisterende kunder ved at identificere uudnyttet salgspotentiale, skarpere sortiment og stærk eksekvering.     Derudover vil dine opgaver være:   Drive salget gennem en proaktiv og struktureret kundeindsats, primært fra hovedkontoret kombineret med fysiske kundebesøg.  I starten vil det være naturligt at opbygge relationer gennem fysisk tilstedeværelse, hvorefter arbejdsrytmen forventes at være cirka fire dage på kontoret og én dag ude hos kunder.  Forberede kundedialoger ved at analysere salgsdata, identificere udviklingsmuligheder og omsætte indsigter til konkrete salgsinitiativer.  Sikre systematisk opfølgning på kunder med henblik på at øge salget, styrke relationerne og sikre, at kunderne køber de rette produkter og mængder.  Bindeled mellem kunder og indkøbsteam, hvor du via din videreformidling af markedsindsigter er med til at sikre rette produkter, mængder og kampagner.       Brænder for salg og formår at eksekvere   Din personlighed er helt afgørende for at lykkes i rollen og organisationen, som fortsat drives i en iværksætterånd. Du skal brænde for salg og trives i et miljø med højt tempo. Du har et stærkt købmandsgen, er serviceminded og formår at sætte dig ind i kundens sted. Du er nysgerrig og har en opsøgende tilgang til nye muligheder, som du også formår at eksekvere på.     Der kan være flere erfaringsbaggrunde til rollen, men hvor følgende erfaringer vægtes:   Erfaring med detailbranchen, enten via salg ind til detailkæder eller fra den anden side i en indkøbsfunktion, hvor du nu ønsker at prøve kræfter med en mere kommerciel rolle.  Salgserfaring fra en kontekst, hvor data har været en naturlig del af din arbejdsproces.  Erfaring med at sælge en bred palet af produktgrupper, både food og nonfood. description: Join us on our exciting journey!   IQVIA™ is The Human Data Science Company™, focused on using data and science to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. This role combines customer success (50%) and revenue growth/account development (50%), helping customers maximize the value of IQVIA's healthcare technology solutions while identifying opportunities for expansion and renewal. The ability to act as a bridge between business users and technical experts is critical.  Experience in customer success, implementation, or consulting within healthcare technology or Health IT. description: 🏢  SOBRE ALSEA EN EUROPA    Alsea  es la empresa líder en restauración organizada. En España, contamos con un portfolio multimarca integrado por Starbucks, Domino's Pizza, Foster's Hollywood, VIPS, y Ginos. Además, disponemos de  4 fábricas propias  que garantizan una calidad óptima y sabor excepcional, para seguir ofreciendo  experiencias llenas de sabor.   En España, sumamos el talento de  más de 23.000 de personas  que trabajamos para entregar felicidad a más de  450 millones de clientes al año en el mundo.   En Alsea estamos inmersos en que nuestra empresa tenga cada vez más un carácter global, que los procesos de rigen y gobiernan nuestra compañía sean iguales en cualquiera de los países en los que operamos, por ello es imprescindible que nuestros ERP estén alineados y consigamos que los flujos de trabajo sean cada vez más globales y unificados. Por este motivo, nuestro departamento de Tecnologías de la Información busca tres nuevas figuras que nos permitan homogeneizar en SAP los flujos de trabajo de distintas áreas estratégicas, gestionando diversos proyectos.   🎯   SOBRE EL ROL DE  CRM & Loyalty Manager  Actualmente buscamos una persona apasionada por el cliente, los datos y la fidelización para liderar la estrategia CRM y Loyalty de nuestras marcas en España y México. Tendrás la oportunidad de diseñar experiencias personalizadas, desarrollar campañas innovadoras y convertir el conocimiento del consumidor en iniciativas que impulsen el crecimiento, la recurrencia y el vínculo emocional con nuestras marcas.   Entre Sus Funciones Principales Destacan     Diseñar y liderar la estrategia de CRM y fidelización para nuestras marcas en España y México, impulsando la recurrencia, el engagement y el valor de nuestros clientes.  Crear, planificar y ejecutar campañas de comunicación personalizadas a través de email marketing, app, push notifications y otros canales, optimizando la experiencia del cliente en cada punto de contacto.  Desarrollar estrategias avanzadas de segmentación y personalización, adaptando ofertas, promociones y contenidos a los intereses y hábitos de consumo de cada cliente.  Liderar y desarrollar al equipo, impulsando las mejores prácticas en customer journeys, automatización y marketing relacional para maximizar la conversión y el impacto comercial.  Analizar el comportamiento de los clientes y los principales KPIs de fidelización para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento, mejora de la experiencia y aumento de la vinculación con las marcas.  Transformar los datos en insights accionables, elaborando presentaciones y recomendaciones estratégicas para la Dirección que ayuden a impulsar la toma de decisiones.  Identificar y liderar mejoras en las herramientas de CRM, automatización y gestión de campañas, coordinando proveedores y garantizando su evolución y correcto funcionamiento.  Desarrollar nuevas alianzas y acuerdos con partners estratégicos que aporten valor diferencial y experiencias relevantes para nuestros clie

title: Customer Quality Manager
description: Job description:   We are looking for a  Customer Quality Manager  to join our Products and Technologies organization within Vaisala Industrial Measurements, at our headquarters in Vantaa, Finland. This is a strategic, highly visible role: you'll turn field and customer insight into real product decisions, and unite R&D, Operations, Service and Sales around shared customer quality goals.      Vaisala is a global leader in measurement instruments and intelligence helping industries, nations, people, and the planet to thrive. From predicting hurricanes to optimizing renewable energy production, our technology is used where it matters the most – from data centers, windfarms and laboratories to airports, the Arctic and even the surface of Mars. For a second year running, Vaisala got recognized in TIME Magazine's World's Best Companies in Sustainable Growth 2026 study. Our team of close to 2,500 experts and 62 nationalities around the world is committed to taking every measure for the planet. Driven by our shared purpose, curiosity, and pioneering spirit, we stay ahead and make a difference. At Vaisala, you don't have to fit in to belong.         Why join us?     •    Join a growing, profitable business at the heart of critical industries like semiconductors, data centers, batteries, power transmission and life sciences. •    Work with market-leading products, backed by continuous innovation and strong investment in new development. •    Take on a genuinely end-to-end, cross-functional role spanning the full value chain, in close partnership with the business.          What's your role?     You will be part of our Products and Technologies organization, working alongside experienced, cross-functional professionals in R&D and product management. Together, you will have an excellent opportunity to define what quality means for our customers, and make sure that what we learn from the field – complaints, returns and failures – is turned into real improvements in our products, processes and ways of working. You'll work closely with R&D, Operations/Manufacturing, Service & Support, Sales/Account management, and the wider Quality organization. You will report to Vice President, VIM Products and Technologies.    •    Own customer quality requirements and be the trusted, customer-facing voice on quality — including negotiating quality agreements.  •    Own complaint handling and the 8D process end-to-end: lead the cases that matter and keep every ticket moving to closure.  •    Lead root cause analyses and equip teams with structured problem-solving tools.  •    Turn returns and failure data into strategic input for R&D and product management — this is what sets the role apart: your insight shapes design decisions and the roadmap, not just closes tickets.  •    Prepare and host customer audits, and drive closure on internal audit findings.  •    Drive yield improvements with Operations and R&D, and continuously sharpen our q

title: Teamleiterin / Teamleiter Servicecenter  (80-100%)
description: SVA Aargau ist das Kompetenzzentrum für Sozialversicherungen im Kanton Aargau. Rund 550 Mitarbeitende engagieren sich täglich für die Selbstbestimmung und Existenzsicherung der Menschen im Kanton. Dabei verbindet SVA Aargau eine stabile und zuverlässige Leistungserbringung mit dem Anspruch, ihre Prozesse, Technologien und Dienstleistungen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.       Für eine neu geschaffene Führungsposition suchen wir eine erfahrene und verbindliche Persönlichkeit. Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle in einer laufenden Transformation und führst zwei bisher eigenständige Servicecenter zu einer gemeinsamen Einheit innerhalb des Bereichs Operations zusammen. Dabei verantwortest du die personelle Führung von ca. 10-12 Mitarbeitenden und stellst gleichzeitig einen stabilen und qualitativ hochwertigen Betrieb sicher. Darauf aufbauend entwickelst du das neue Servicecenter weiter, harmonisierst Prozesse, etablierst eine wirkungsvolle Steuerung und treibst Digitalisierung, Automatisierung sowie die professionelle Zusammenarbeit mit externen Partnerunternehmen voran.       Deine Herausforderung    Führung, Teamintegration und Veränderung (ca. 30–40%)    Du führst und entwickelst ein Team von ca. 10–12 Mitarbeitenden und begleitest das Zusammenwachsen der beiden bisherigen Servicecenter zu einer gemeinsamen Einheit.  In der Veränderungsphase schaffst du Orientierung, klärst Verantwortlichkeiten und stärkst eine gemeinsame, wertschätzende Teamkultur.  Bestehendes Fach- und Prozesswissen sicherst du gezielt und begleitest Veränderungen bei Rollen, Aufgaben und Kapazitäten transparent, empathisch und verbindlich.  Ziele, Leistung und Entwicklung steuerst du verbindlich. Konflikte gehst du frühzeitig und konstruktiv an.    Operative Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung (ca. 50%)    Du stellst sicher, dass das Tagesgeschäft und die im Servicekatalog definierten Leistungen zuverlässig, termingerecht und in der geforderten Qualität erbracht werden.  Du setzt die harmonisierten Prozesse um und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter. Qualität, Mengen und Kapazitäten steuerst du anhand geeigneter Kennzahlen.  Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen entwickelst du den Servicekatalog entlang der strategischen Ziele weiter. Zudem verantwortest du Budget und Controlling deiner Kostenstelle.  Du treibst Digitalisierung und Automatisierung voran, insbesondere bei der automatisierten Dokumentenzuordnung und einer neuen digitalen Posteingangslösung. Dabei übernimmst du fachlich die Product-Owner-Rolle und arbeitest gemeinsam mit der internen Applikationsverantwortlichen in der IT. Leistungsvorgaben, Mengen, Fristen und Qualität überwachst du anhand von Kennzahlen und Auswertungen. Bei Abweichungen leitest du konkrete Verbesserungen ein. Fondata nel 2020, opera con un approccio Phygital, collaborando con le Case Automobilistiche (OEM) e 11 partner di Noleggio a Lungo Termine (NLT). Fornire indicazioni e procedure precise per la forza vendita interna nell’adozione dei nuovi canali; coordinare il fornitore e le eventuali risorse dedicate, monitorandone attività e prestazioni.  Raccogliere feedback e analizzare i KPI per migliorare il servizio dopo l’avvio; contribuire, nelle successive evoluzioni, a strutturare le interfacce con le società di noleggio. title: Chargé de clientèle

Aptitudes professionnelles :       • Aisance relationnelle et sens du service client ;  • Appétence appréciée du secteur informatique en général ;  • Diplomatie, pédagogie et capacité d’adaptation ;  • Esprit d’équipe et capacité à travailler en transversal ;  • Rigueur et autonomie dans le suivi des dossiers.      Formation :       • Bac +2 minimum, avec expérience dans la relation client, le support ou la gestion de comptes, idéalement dans un environnement numérique ou éducation-recherche ;  • Niveau équivalent à la branche d’activité professionnelle (BAP) du RÉFérentiel des Emplois-types de la Recherche et de l'Enseignement Supérieur : E4X41 - Technicien-ne d'exploitation, d'assistance et de traitement de l'information.      Conditions et avanatages :       • Possibilité de télétravailler de 1 à 2 jours flexibles par semaine ;  • Environnement de travail polyvalent au sein d’une équipe à taille humaine ;  • Protection sociale complémentaire attractive :  o Participation employeur de 70% pour la mutuelle et de 100% pour la prévoyance ;  o Retraite sur-complémentaire avec une participation employeur de 75% (pour les CDI) ;  • 25 jours ouvrés de congés payés et 23 jours de RTT ;  • Lieu de travail agréable dans le 13ème arrondissement de Paris ;  • Titres-restaurant avec une participation employeur de 60% ;  • Compléments de formation possibles à l’entrée en fonction.      Détail des missions :       • Accueillir, écouter et analyser les besoins des utilisateurs des réseaux et services RENATER ;  • Conseiller et proposer des solutions adaptées à partir du catalogue de services RENATER ;  • Accompagner la mise en œuvre et la mise en service des solutions ;  • Assurer le suivi de la satisfaction et de la qualité de service, via notamment les outils utilisés pour le support utilisateurs, et l’organisation de comités ad-hoc, de visites terrain et autres évènements dédiés ;  • Réaliser le suivi administratif de la relation client en lien avec les services de la DGS : conventions, bons de commande, facturation, reporting etc... ;  • Contribuer à la mise à jour des bases de donné

title: Kundenberater:in Media & Performance
description: Über uns  Wir sind ein erfahrenes und ambitioniertes Team für digitales Marketing und crossmediale Kampagnen. Unsere Agentur liegt mitten in Zürich, direkt beim Hauptbahnhof. Wir challengen den Status Quo der Branche und setzen eigene neue Standards. So gestalten wir die Agentur der Zukunft. Wir bieten unseren Kunden alles für erfolgreiche Werbeaktivitäten: Von strategischer Beratung über die Planung und Umsetzung von On- und Offline-Massnahmen bis hin zu Tracking- & Analytics-Lösungen.  Reizen dich spannende Projekte und ein kollegiales Team? Wir bringen dich weiter. Dann nutze jetzt deine Chance und bewirb dich als   So sehen deine Aufgaben bei uns aus:  Als Kundenberater:in bist du der zentrale Kontakt für unsere Kunden. Du berätst sie über alle Disziplinen unserer Agentur und entwickelst ganzheitlich, wirkungsvolle Kampagnenkonzepte und Strategien. Dabei steuerst du die Kundenprojekte und arbeitest eng mit unserem Ad-Ops-Team sowie den zuständigen Campaign Managern zusammen. Dein Interesse für neue Technologien und KI bringst du aktiv ein und nutzt neue Möglichkeiten, um unsere Kampagnenarbeit sinnvoll weiterzuentwickeln.  Diese Position passt zu dir, wenn du gerne Verantwortung für deine eigenen Kunden übernimmst und sie langfristig begleiten möchtest.      Du betreust deine Kunden ganzheitlich über alle Disziplinen unserer Agentur.  Gemeinsam mit dem Kunden entwickelst du die Strategie und den Media-Mix weiter.  Du planst regelmässige Kundenmeetings und Reviews und führst sie durch.  Für die Umsetzung briefst du unsere Specialists im Ad-Ops-Team.  Budget, Ertrag und Projektfortschritt hast du jederzeit im Blick.  Du bringst neue technische Möglichkeiten aktiv in die Kundenberatung ein.    Folgendes zeichnet dich aus:   Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in der Beratung von Performance-Marketing-Kunden mit.  Du arbeitest stark kundenorientiert, sorgfältig und behältst auch in komplexen Projekten den Überblick.  Analytisches Denken und ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen zeichnen dich aus.  Du denkst strategisch und unternehmerisch.  Neue Tools und Trends im Marketing interessieren dich.  Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher und überzeugend.      Das wartet auf dich:   Dich erwarten aussergewöhnliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und du gestaltest die Agentur der Zukunft aktiv mit.  Erfahrene Sparringpartner begleiten dich bei strategischen Kundenthemen.  Du geniesst kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Selbstverantwortung und ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima.  Du verantwortest anspruchsvolle Projekte für Kunden aus unterschiedlichen Branchen.  Dein Arbeitsplatz liegt zentral im Herzen von Zürich, mit Home-Office-Tagen, einem stets gefüllten Kühlschrank und tollen Team-Events.       Du fühlst dich angesprochen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Über uns   Intonate ist ein Tech-Startup aus Zürich mit einer klaren Mission: Wir wollen die neuesten Entwicklungen im Bereich der Künstlichen Intelligenz nutzen, um das europäische Gesundheitssystem nachhaltig zu verbessern.     Unsere Technologie reduziert den administrativen Aufwand im medizinischen Alltag. Intonate erstellt medizinische Berichte in Echtzeit – direkt aus Arzt-Patienten-Gesprächen und integriert in führende Praxis- und Klinikinformationssysteme. So gewinnen Ärzt:innen mehr Zeit für das, was wirklich zählt: ihre Patient:innen.     Wenn du die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mitgestalten, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit einem ambitionierten Gründerteam etwas aufbauen möchtest, bist du bei uns richtig.     Wer bei Intonate einsteigt, entscheidet sich für drei Dinge:       Wir übernehmen Verantwortung:  Verantwortung zählt mehr als Titel, Ergebnisse mehr als Absichten.   Wir streben nach Exzellenz:  Wir setzen hohe Standards und geben direktes, konstruktives und egofreies Feedback.   Wir wachsen gemeinsam:  als Team und zusammen mit unseren Kund:innen.      Unsere Mission steht über dem Ego. Alle leisten ihren Beitrag, übernehmen Verantwortung und gestalten die Zukunft von Intonate aktiv mit.      Deine Aufgaben   Als zentrale Ansprechperson für Customer Success bringst du die Zufriedenheit und den Erfolg unserer Kund:innen auf ein neues Niveau. Du begleitest medizinische Institutionen von den ersten Gesprächen über das Onboarding bis zur langfristigen Nutzung unserer Lösung.  Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Gründerteam von Intonate sowie mit Entscheidungsträger:innen in Arztpraxen und Kliniken zusammen. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Kund:innen den grösstmöglichen Nutzen aus Intonate ziehen, und trägst entscheidend dazu bei, unsere Präsenz in der Schweiz und darüber hinaus auszubauen.      Was du bei uns bewegst       Kund:innen erfolgreich machen   Du begleitest neue Kund:innen durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess und führst massgeschneiderte Trainings durch. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass Intonate schnell, sicher und gewinnbringend in den medizinischen Alltag integriert wird.  Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für fachliche und produktspezifische Fragen und sorgst für einen schnellen, verlässlichen und hochwertigen Support.      Langfristige Beziehungen aufbauen   Du entwickelst vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Stakeholdern in Arztpraxen und Kliniken. Durch regelmässige Check-ins, Feedbackgespräche und Produkt-Updates stellst du sicher, dass wir die Bedürfnisse unserer Kund:innen verstehen und langfristig erfüllen.  Du übersetzt das Feedback unserer Nutzer:innen in konkrete Erkenntnisse und arbeitest eng mit dem Produktteam zusammen, um Intonate kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.      Intonate überzeugend präsentieren   Du identifizierst relevante Entscheidungsträger:innen in medizinischen Institutionen und sprichst sie gezielt an.  In Produktdemos, Präsentationen und persönlichen Gesprächen vermittel

title: Junior Onboarding Consultant Spain & International
description: As Virtuagym keeps on growing, we are now looking for a new face to complement our International Onboarding team. As Junior Onboarding Consultant, you will be the first point of contact for our local clients/customers and manage their success! Will you join us in our quest to create a healthier and happier world?      Join a high performing team and make an impact!   We're a passionate, driven team with a strong focus on growth and delivering outstanding results. At Virtuagym, we cultivate a high-performance culture built on dedication, ownership and driving excellence. If you're a self-starter who embraces challenges, thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and keeps going where others might stop, this could be the perfect role for you! In return, you’ll join a team where you can grow, develop, and truly unlock your full potential.     Our head office is situated in the center of Amsterdam and while we foster getting together to exchange ideas and energy, we are a remote-friendly company. This is a full time and remote position from Spain where you will be working for our global teams.      What this role looks like   As Junior Onboarding Consultant, you will be a key player responsible for the growth and development of Virtuagym as well as establishing a strong connection with our customers. You will add to the process of engaging and motivating our clients to use our software and expanding our customer base every day.   A good start is half the battle, so you make sure that new customers get value from their new software package as quickly as possible. This makes them successful with the software and with their business. So they can focus on making their customers healthier and happier.  With your listening ear and enthusiasm you give tailored advice and make sure your customers become Virtuagym fans.  You are responsible for the onboarding of your own portfolio of starting clients. You advise your clients in the software implementation from A to Z.  Through your service and involvement during consultations with your clients and the careful follow-up of issues, you ensure the highest possible customer satisfaction. title: SAP Manager
description: PTE consulting è una società di consulenza aziendale che accompagna i propri clienti nel loro percorso di Digital Transformation, sviluppando soluzioni di business e sistemi IT per migliorare i processi aziendali nelle aree AFC, Treasury, Operations e Supply Chain.  Lavoriamo con importanti clienti internazionali guidandoli nell'innovazione dei processi aziendali, progettando nuove soluzioni che consentano di gestire le prossime sfide tecnologiche e raggiungere il successo.  Stiamo ricercando un Manager con consolidate competenze tecniche, organizzative e commerciali nella gestione di progetti e attività legate al ciclo di vita di sistemi SAP e dell'infrastruttura in ambienti ibridi. La figura selezionata sarà responsabile delle scelte tecniche e architetturali dell'infrastruttura SAP, del coordinamento di attività e persone, della gestione della relazione con il cliente.  In particolare, si occuperà di:    gestire e coordinare progetti e attività SAP Basis, dalla pianificazione alla realizzazione e al go-live;  coordinare le risorse coinvolte nelle attività, organizzandone priorità, carichi di lavoro e responsabilità;  interfacciarsi direttamente con il cliente, comprendendone le esigenze e assicurando il corretto avanzamento delle attività;  partecipare a meeting di progetto e attività di SAL, pianificazione e reporting;  supportare la definizione di soluzioni tecniche e architetturali in ambito SAP Basis;  svolgere e supervisionare attività operative sui sistemi SAP, tra cui installazioni, configurazioni, upgrade, migrazioni, monitoring, troubleshooting e gestione delle performance;  coordinare attività di manutenzione, aggiornamento e gestione del ciclo di vita dei sistemi SAP;  collaborare con i team funzionali e tecnici coinvolti nei progetti, favorendo l'integrazione tra le diverse aree;  gestire eventuali criticità tecniche e organizzative, individuando le opportune azioni correttive;  contribuire alla gestione delle attività progettuali anche sotto il profilo di tempi, effort e priorità;  supportare, quando necessario, le attività di prevendita e la definizione di stime e soluzioni per nuovi progetti     Requirements   Cerchiamo profili con ampia esperienza progettuale, di coordinamento e sviluppo di business.  E' inoltre necessaria ampia conoscenza tecnica delle soluzioni SAP, di progetti di upgrade, migrazione o installazione di ambienti SAP.   Benefits   In aggiunta alla retribuzione fissa sono previsti una componente bonus (variabile in base a risultati aziendali e performance individuali), buoni pasto, assicurazione sanitaria aziendale.  Ti troverai in un ambiente giovane e collaborativo, che promuove una cultura che valorizza diversità, equità e inclusione.

title: SAP Manager | Cliente Finale Manifatturiero
description: La tua nuova azienda   Il nostro cliente è un’azienda manifatturiera del settore Machinery / Metalmeccanico, leader nella progettazione e produzione di macchinari complessi e soluzioni industriali ad alta tecnologia.  In un contesto di forte espansione e modernizzazione dei sistemi informativi, l’azienda sta avviando un progetto strategico di migrazione a SAP S/4HANA, con integrazione dei principali sistemi applicativi (PLM, CAD, MES, CRM, HR) e un approccio metodologico orientato al Clean Core.      Il tuo nuovo ruolo   Entrerai in azienda come Responsabile dell’Area Applicativi, un ruolo centrale nella governance del progetto SAP S/4HANA e nella gestione dei processi applicativi. Dopo un periodo iniziale di affiancamento al Direttore IT, durante il quale acquisirai familiarità con i flussi aziendali e con gli strumenti attualmente in uso, assumerai piena autonomia nella gestione delle attività e nella supervisione del team interno composto da tre specialisti.  Sarai responsabile dell’analisi dei processi, della mappatura dei flussi esistenti e della definizione dei modelli futuri, con particolare attenzione alla produzione su commessa, alla costificazione, all’avanzamento e all’integrazione con i sistemi PLM e CAD. Gestirai tutte le fasi del progetto SAP S/4HANA, dal blueprint alla realizzazione, dal testing alla definizione e coordinamento delle attività UAT, fino al go-live e al supporto post avvio. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con i consulenti esterni, verificando la qualità delle configurazioni e delle customizzazioni e garantendo che le soluzioni proposte rispecchino fedelmente le esigenze operative dell’azienda.  Avrai inoltre la responsabilità di coordinare il team interno, assegnando le attività in base alle priorità e intervenendo direttamente quando necessario per risolvere problematiche tecniche o funzionali.  Il tuo ruolo richiederà una visione trasversale sui moduli SAP FI/CO, MM, PP, QM, SD, CS, PM, EWM e PS, una profonda conoscenza dei processi industriali e una forte capacità di dialogo con i responsabili delle diverse funzioni aziendali, con l’obiettivo di semplificare i flussi, ridurre le customizzazioni e garantire un’implementazione coerente con le linee guida del progetto.      Di cosa hai bisogno per aver successo   Per avere successo in questo ruolo è necessario aver maturato almeno cinque-sette anni di esperienza su SAP, preferibilmente in aziende del settore Machinery o Impiantistica, con partecipazione documentata a progetti full life cycle. È fondamentale una conoscenza approfondita della produzione su commessa e del modulo SAP PS, oltre a una solida padronanza dei principali moduli applicativi. Completano il profilo la familiarità con applicativi come CRM, HR Zucchetti, Microsoft 365 e Power BI, la conoscenza dei sistemi di ingegneria come Teamcenter, NX CAD/CAM ed EPLAN, e una buona comprensione dei sistemi MES e delle logiche Industria 4.0 e 5.0. title: Customer Success Manager, Enterprise (Missouri Valley)
description:
Headquarters:  Remote - USA
 

 About the Role 
 As a Customer Success Manager   at Abnormal AI, you will serve as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, focusing on successful onboarding, adoption, and ongoing value delivery. You will build and nurture strong customer relationships, align on business goals, and drive measurable outcomes through best practice adoption and strategic planning. You will proactively identify opportunities and risks to help customers maximize their investment and contribute valuable feedback for product improvements. Your role involves collaboration with cross-functional teams and maintaining customer satisfaction and retention. 
 Who you are 
 
 Skilled at building trust and maintaining relationships with stakeholders at various organizational levels, including executives 
 Action-oriented, analytical, and collaborative in approach to customer success and issue resolution 
 Dedicated to delivering measurable customer value and ensuring satisfaction throughout the customer lifecycle 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills, comfortable handling both strategic discussions and technical conversations 
 Solid technical understanding of SaaS products, including internet technologies, networking, and email security solutions 
 Proven track record of driving product adoption and supporting long-term customer growth 
 
 What you will do 
 
 Act as the main point of contact for assigned customers, developing strategic relationships and guiding platform adoption and success planning 
 Deliver regular business reviews (QBRs/EBRs), clearly communicating ROI and aligning on success metrics to support retention and expansion 
 Understand customers’ industries, goals, and challenges to provide tailored recommendations and align internal and external stakeholders on success objectives 
 Promote awareness and usage of key platform features, provide ongoing education, and identify opportunities for expanded adoption 
 Proactively monitor customer health, manage escalations, and collaborate with Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales teams to resolve issues and share actionable insights 
 Maintain expert knowledge of the product roadmap and communicate relevant updates and enhancements to customers 
 Coordinate with internal teams to develop and execute customer success plans, addressing risks before they impact engagement or satisfaction

 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS, with at least 3+ years in Customer Success, TAM, or support roles 
 Proven ability to manage large customer portfolios and develop long-term relationships, including at the executive level 
 Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills, capable of managing both strategic and technical conversations effectively 
 Strong problem-solving skills and experience resolving escalations while maintaining a positive customer experience 
 Proficiency with CRM and case management tools such as Sales

title: Frontend Engineer

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

title: CENTRALE LYON ENISE - Post doctorat - Modélisation et optimisation de la sphéroïdisation de poudres métalliques par plasma RF
description:
Le poste est basé à Centrale Lyon ENISE, sur le campus stéphanois, qui accueille plus de 1250 élèves et 160 personnels, dans un environnement exceptionnel aux portes du Pilat. Centrale Lyon ENISE forme des ingénieurs de spécialité Génie mécanique, Génie civil, Génie sensoriel sous statut étudiant (FISE) ou sous statut apprenti (FISA).

DESCRIPTIF

Contexte scientifique :

Dans le cadre d'un projet ANR consacré au traitement et à la fonctionnalisation de poudres métalliques par plasma radiofréquence, le laboratoire souhaite recruter un post-doc pour développer une approche couplant modélisation physique, expérimentation et optimisation des paramètres de procédé.

Le travail portera principalement sur la sphéroïdisation de poudres d'AlSi10Mg par plasma RF inductif, réalisée sur une torche TekSphero40 (40 kW). Le procédé vise à transformer des particules initialement irrégulières en particules sphériques adaptées notamment aux procédés de fabrication additive métallique.

Le projet s'intéresse à un problème scientifique fortement couplé. L'augmentation de l'énergie apportée aux particules favorise leur fusion et leur sphéroïdisation, mais peut simultanément accentuer l'évaporation du magnésium, la formation de nanoparticules et la coalescence des particules en vol. L'objectif est donc de rechercher un compromis optimal entre plusieurs critères de qualité de la poudre.

Verrous scientifiques :

La fabrication additive métallique par fusion laser sur lit de poudre (L-PBF) nécessite des poudres très sphériques, coulables et chimiquement homogènes. Le procédé de sphéroïdisation par plasma à couplage inductif radiofréquence (RF) est une voie industrielle intéressante pour répondre à ces besoins. Dans ce procédé, la poudre traverse un plasma d'argon à 10 000 K, fond en vol (~ 5 -150 ms) et se resolidifie en gouttelette sphérique sous l'effe

Your Role

We ship fast, and we intend to keep shipping fast. The consequence is that our system is outgrowing the amount of deliberate design that went into it. We run AI agents over customer documents in a domain where being wrong is expensive, and a lot of the load-bearing decisions about how those fit together are still implicit.

You will be making those decisions explicit and then making them hold. That means codifying golden paths, building the shared primitives and APIs that product engineers work on top of, owning the architecture of the system as a whole, and establishing what our reliability actually needs to be before an incident establishes it for us.

Platform at Cortea sits between software engineering, DevOps and SRE. Its customers are other engineers. This is not a DevOps role under a different name: you will spend more time in application code than in YAML, and the reason we want infrastructure experience is that we don't believe you can design a system well without being able to run it.

The bar we are hiring against is someone who has taken a system from nothing to production and owned it end to end. You picked the technology, argued the tradeoffs in writing, provisioned the infrastructure, and were responsible for it when it broke.


On AI

We use AI heavily and we want you to. What we are not looking for is someone who outsources their judgment to it.

The mental model of this system has to live in your head, not in a context window. Use agents to move quickly on implementation. Do the design, the reasoning and the writing yourself, and be able to defend every decision you ship.

Je zorgt dat je team dat overzicht net zo scherp heeft en dat de dagelijkse focus daarop ligt. Je maakt duidelijk waarom dat ertoe doet: het is goed voor de klant, maar het zijn ook onze targets, onze omzet en onze groei. Commercie is voor jou geen bijzaak, maar een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van customer success. Wordt een target niet gehaald? Dan zoek je uit waarom en los je het op.  Je motiveert liever dan dat je opdrachten geeft. Je neemt je team mee in het waarom, zodat ze niet volgen omdat het moet, maar omdat ze voelen dat het ertoe doet.  Je ziet commercie als onderdeel van succes. Je begrijpt dat klanten moeten groeien en partners moeten verdienen, en dat wij daarin meegroeien. Je spreekt makkelijk over targets, NRR en upsell-kansen, en je stuurt er ook op.          Wat vragen we van jou?    Minstens vijf jaar saleservaring. Ervaring in customer success is een pré, maar een ervaren salesmanager is ook welkom.  Vijf jaar ervaring in leidinggeven.  Een commerciële mentaliteit. Je begrijpt NRR, upsell, churn en portfoliomanagement, en je stuurt er actief op. Omzet en groei zijn voor jou geen bijzaak, maar een KPI waar je dagelijks naar handelt.  Nederlands en Engels op niveau.  Een hbo- of wo-opleidingsachtergrond.       Wat krijg je van ons?    Autonomie:    Je krijgt eigenaarschap en vertrouwen. Je weet samen met je team waar jullie naartoe werken en bepaalt zelf hoe. Je krijgt vrijheid, en de verantwoordelijkheid die daarbij hoort.  Je ziet je impact terug. Partners die groeien, eindgebruikers die productiever worden en churn die daalt. Ook je team voelt dat resultaat.  Je krijgt ruimte om te bouwen. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Why now   Companies are building their sales and marketing workflows on incomplete information. We've spent a decade building and classifying 30 million pages of Nordic business data. But having clean information is just the start. Making it work in their processes and matter to their business is the real challenge. That's where you come in.  We're looking for a business-savvy, forward-looking Customer Success Manager who learns fast. Start as soon as possible. Q4 is peak season: companies are reviewing the year, making budget calls, planning ahead. You'll jump into real conversations from day one. That's where the actual learning happens.   The role   You work with roughly 120 mid-market customers. This isn't account management. It's about being a thought partner who helps them actually get value from Vainu.  They bought Vainu because they have a specific problem they want to solve. Your job is helping them out to do that.  That means    Understand what they actually need. What did they buy Vainu for? What's the pain they're trying to fix in their revenue process?  Help them think it through. Work with them to identify which parts of their workflow are worth automating and where Vainu's data creates real value. Often this means helping them see opportunities in their own internal processes.  Steer and inspire. You're not just checking in on your customers, but actively helping them imagine what's possible when they combine Vainu's data with their expertise. Showing them how other customers are using Vainu in interesting ways.  Hold them accountable (and yourself too). Getting value from Vainu usually requires work from both sides. Sometimes it's changes they need to make, and sometimes it's work we need to do. You help drive forward that partnership.    Here's the reality: you don't have 120 equal relationships. You need to be smart about where you spend time. Look at the real value each customer is getting from our data. Focus your energy on conversations that make a difference. You need business sense and the ability to have honest conversations about what it actually takes to succeed.   What We Need From You     Experience: 1–2 years of Customer Success in a high-churn, high-growth SaaS environment where you had to fight for retention and prove value. Or equivalent: someone from a broader TAM SaaS business who's learned to be scrappy and resourceful with a large customer base. You have a track record of hitting retention targets and growing accounts in competitive conditions.  Tech mindset: You build things to save yourself time: agents, automations, whatever works. You constantly ask: Am I actually adding value here, or could a machine do this? You understand CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Dynamics, Pipedrive) and how RevOps works. You're genuinely curious about how data flows through a customer's workflow, and you're not afraid to tell them "here's what I'd try". Ti  proponiamo due strade, a tua scelta:     1) Collaborazione con partita IVA.     Se la gara viene aggiudicata, l'incarico parte per i tre anni di contratto    con un impegno part-time concordato e un compenso a giornata o a canone mensile.     2) Assunzione a tempo determinato. description: Vil du lede med engasjement, retning og kundefokus? title: Customer Service Team Manager
description: ABOUT QUINCE   Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.  What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.   OUR CULTURE   Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.    We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.  Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.   Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.     If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.   The Role:     Customer Service Team Manager   We are seeking a German-bilingual Customer Service Team Manager to build and lead our founding German Customer Experience team, based in our Center of Excellence in Barcelona on a hybrid schedule. This is a hands-on, people-first leadership role responsible for standing up and scaling a high-performing CX team that delivers consistently exceptional customer experiences across all channels—phone, chat, email, and social—for our German-speaking customers.  Fluency in both German and English is required, as you will hire, coach, and develop frontline German-speaking Customer Experience Specialists while collaborating across our global CX organization

Notre force réside dans notre capacité à activer à la fois expertise métier et maîtrise technologique pour accompagner les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans toutes leurs transformations.    Au sein du Groupe, notre activité est dédiée aux secteurs du Luxe et du Retail. Nous accompagnons les directions métiers et informatiques sur des projets e-Commerce, Data, Customer Experience, Digital in Store, PIM-DAM, PLM, Supply Chain ou encore Green Transition.    VISION IN ACTION    Dans un environnement où les mutations s'accélèrent, les organisations doivent en permanence réinventer leurs modèles pour rester compétitives. Pour y répondre, nous accompagnons nos clients de la définition de leur stratégie à sa mise en œuvre opérationnelle, en combinant expertise métier, maîtrise technologique et capacité d'exécution.    Rejoindre Magellan, c'est intégrer un collectif de 6 700 talents engagés, unis par une même exigence : comprendre les enjeux dans toute leur complexité pour construire des solutions concrètes et activables au plus près des réalités du terrain.    Magellan est classé 3e Best Workplace France (Palmarès Great Place To Work 2024) et n°1 des entreprises où faire accélérer sa carrière (Classement Linkedin Top Companies 2025).      Description du poste    Le métier de Key Account Manager dans le Luxe et le Retail combine développement commercial, fidélisation clients et gestion de comptes stratégiques. Ce poste s'adresse à un Key Account Manager expérimenté, capable de piloter et développer un grand compte stratégique pour le cabinet.     💡 VOS MISSIONS     En tant que Key Account Manager (H/F), vous accompagnez nos clients dans leurs projets en développant votre relation de partenariat avec vos interlocuteurs (métier, opérationnel, digital ou IT). Vous êtes au cœur de la stratégie commerciale du cabinet, en mettant en valeur le savoir-faire des offres et en pilotant le développement d'un ou plusieurs comptes stratégiques grâce à l'identification de nouvelles opportunités business.
