title: Key Account Manager – Strategisk HMS-rådgiver - Ledige stillinger - Avonova Helse AS
description: Avonova søker en erfaren Key Account Manager som kan kombinere solid HMS-kompetanse med sterk forretningsforståelse. Vi ser etter deg som evner å omsette arbeidsmiljø, helse og sikkerhet til konkret verdi for kunden gjennom redusert risiko, økt produktivitet og et mer bærekraftig arbeidsliv.  Som KAM hos oss får du ansvar for en egen portefølje av større kunder. Du bygger sterke relasjoner med ledere og beslutningstakere, identifiserer behov og bidrar til at kundene lykkes med sitt HMS- og arbeidsmiljøarbeid.  Dine viktigste ansvarsområder    Strategisk rådgivning innen arbeidsmiljø, HMS og organisatorisk utvikling   Videreutvikling av egen kundeportefølje gjennom tett oppfølging og sterk forretningsforståelse   Rådgivning til ledere, HR, vernetjeneste og arbeidsmiljøutvalg   Deltakelse i AMU og andre sentrale kundeprosesser   Koordinering av tverrfaglige leveranser fra Avonovas fagmiljøer   Bidra til høy kundetilfredshet, lojalitet og langsiktig verdiskaping     Vi ser etter deg som har    Høyere utdanning innen HMS, arbeidsmiljø, HR, organisasjon, ledelse eller tilsvarende   Solid erfaring med systematisk HMS-arbeid og arbeidsmiljøutvikling   Erfaring fra rådgivning mot ledere og beslutningstakere   God forretningsforståelse og evne til å se sammenhengen mellom arbeidsmiljø, risiko, sykefravær og virksomhetsresultater   Erfaring med kundeansvar, relasjonsbygging eller Key Account Management er en fordel     Personlige egenskaper    Du skaper tillit og bygger sterke relasjoner   Du er faglig trygg og trives i rollen som rådgiver   Du er kommersiell, proaktiv og løsningsorientert   Du evner å balansere faglig tyngde med gode kundeopplevelser   Du arbeider strukturert og selvstendig     Vi tilbyr    En sentral rolle hos Norges ledende bedriftshelsetjeneste   Mulighet til å påvirke utviklingen hos noen av våre viktigste kunder   Et av landets sterkeste fagmiljøer innen arbeidshelse og HMS   Gode utviklingsmuligheter, pensjons- og forsikringsordninger   Arbeidssted Ullevål Stadion     Vi behandler søknader fortløpende og oppfordrer deg til å søke så snart som mulig.  Om arbeidsplassen  Avonova er Nordens største bedriftshelsetjeneste (BHT). Hver dag – tidlig og sent – ønsker vi å utgjøre en reell forskjell for tusenvis av arbeidstakere, i tråd med samfunnsoppdraget vi skal levere på. Derfor finner du oss i totalt 130 byer i Norge, Sverige og Finland, tett på våre kunder og samarbeidspartnere. Med ledende ekspertise innen arbeidsmedisin, sykefravær, fysisk og psykososialt arbeidsmiljø, får du aktivt ta del i et bunnsolid fagmiljø med mer enn 1300 dyktige og hyggelige kolleger i tre nordiske land. Vi ser etter deg som finner glød og engasjement i å videreutvikle våre tjenester og tilbud, på vei mot bærekraftige arbeidsplasser som fremmer helse, mangfold og respekt

title: Guest Experience Manager
description: Company Description   Pullman Kuching is centrally located in the Kuching Golden Triangle, enjoying pride of place on Jalan Mathies hill, with panoramic city and river views. The first Pullman hotel in this vibrant city, Pullman Kuching features 389 spacious, contemporary rooms and offers easy access to renowned Borneo national parks. The hotel is ideal for business guests, offering an abundance of conferencing space, state of the art facilities and technology, plus a range of trendy restaurants and bars, and a high-end spa.   Job Description   Job Summary  The Guest Experience Manager is responsible for ensuring guests receive a warm, personalised and memorable experience throughout their stay. The role focuses on guest engagement, service recovery, feedback management and maintaining high guest satisfaction standards.  Key Responsibilities    Oversee and enhance the overall guest experience throughout the hotel.  Welcome and engage with guests, especially VIPs, repeat guests and special occasions.  Proactively identify guest needs and ensure appropriate follow-up during their stay.  Handle guest feedback, complaints and service recovery professionally and promptly.  Monitor guest satisfaction scores and online guest reviews, including TrustYou feedback.  Coordinate with Front Office, Housekeeping, F&B and other departments to resolve guest concerns.  Ensure guest preferences and special requests are properly communicated and followed up.  Conduct regular guest interaction and gather feedback to identify areas for improvement.  Maintain accurate records of guest feedback, complaints and recovery actions.  Support the Front Office team in delivering consistent service standards.  Coach and guide team members on guest engagement and service recovery.  Assist in creating guest engagement initiatives and personalised experiences.  Ensure compliance with hotel and Accor guest experience standards, policies and procedures.  Prepare and share guest experience reports and highlight recurring issues to management.  Perform other duties as assigned by the Rooms Division / Management.     Qualifications     Diploma or Degree in Hospitality Management or a related field.  Minimum 3 years of experience in Front Office, Guest Relations or Guest Experience in a hotel environment.  Strong guest service and communication skills.  Confident in handling guest complaints and service recovery.  Good understanding of hotel operations and guest journey.  Strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills.  Positive, friendly and approachable personality.  Able to work independently and coordinate effectively with different departments.  Good command of English; additional languages are an advantage.  Willing to work shifts, weekends and public holidays.

title: Process & Journey Manager
description: Great customer journeys are built behind the scenes   At If, we're working to make insurance simpler, smarter and more connected across channels. To make that happen, we need to bring together customer journeys, business processes and digital capabilities in a more structured and scalable way.  We're now looking for a  Process and Journey Manager  to help drive that work. You'll work across business and technology to turn customer insights, data and digital capabilities into better customer journeys and more effective end-to-end processes.   About The Role   As a Process and Journey Manager, you'll play a central role in building and improving end-to-end customer journeys and processes across channels. Working across business and technology, you'll use CRM capabilities, customer and process data, and digital platforms to identify opportunities, reduce friction and drive improvements that create value for customers and support business goals.  You'll help connect lifecycle management, journey orchestration and process development into a seamless end-to-end experience. From identifying improvement opportunities and designing solutions to implementation, optimization and governance, you'll play a central role throughout the process. title: Manager- Technical Support
description: Who is Forcepoint?   Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint’s all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2.7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you’re in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we’re missing is you!  Living our team values of Trust, Teamwork, Accountability, and Winning Mindset, the Technical Support Manager provides strategic leadership to a team of Technical Support Engineers and escalation management across Forcepoint's Technical Support organization. You will lead a region-focused team responsible for anticipating, identifying, and resolving the technical support needs of our customers across our full product portfolio.  In this role, you will drive operational excellence through data-informed decision-making, deep product knowledge, and collaborative partnerships with Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success. You will set the bar for technical depth, customer advocacy, and team performance—ensuring customers achieve maximum value from Forcepoint solutions while building a high-performing, retention-focused team.  AI at Forcepoint  At Forcepoint, we believe AI is a force multiplier—not a replacement for human ingenuity. We actively encourage every team member to embrace AI tools as part of their daily workflow: to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive tasks, surface insights faster, and free up cognitive bandwidth for work that requires distinctly human judgment, creativity, and collaboration.  We are building a workforce fluent in AI—one that continuously experiments, learns, and applies emerging tools to deliver greater impact for our customers and mission. People who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a proactive approach to AI-augmented work will thrive here.  Key Responsibilities    Provide strategic day-to-day management and mentorship to a team of Technical Support Engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.  Drive team performance using data-informed insights from Salesforce case analytics, JIRA tracking, and KPI monitoring—translating operational metrics into actionable coaching and process improvements.  Partner with Sales and Sales Engineering to strategically manage high-value customer engagements, identify account health risks, and proactively escalate and resolve critical issues before they impact retention.  Lead Technical Support's incident response and post-incident review for critical customer issues, ensuring root-cause analysis and preventing recurrence. title: Responsable Servicio ATC-Contact Center (Banca)
description: Lidera. Transforma. Haz evolucionar el servicio.   En Servinform buscamos incorporar un/a Responsable de Servicio para liderar un proyecto de Atención al Cliente en Contact Center para una reconocida entidad del sector bancario. Si tienes experiencia gestionando operaciones de Contact Center y buscas un proyecto en el que puedas aportar tu visión, liderar equipos y participar en la transformación de un servicio, queremos conocerte.   ¿Cuál será tu misión?   Serás la persona responsable de liderar la operación y asegurar la evolución del servicio, trabajando de forma cercana con el cliente y con los equipos de Servinform. Tu objetivo será conseguir que la operación alcance sus objetivos de calidad, productividad, eficiencia y experiencia de cliente, anticipándote a las necesidades del negocio y convirtiendo los datos y resultados en oportunidades de mejora. No buscamos únicamente a alguien que gestione el día a día. Buscamos a una persona capaz de entender el negocio, liderar equipos, tomar decisiones y hacer evolucionar el servicio.   ¿Qué harás en tu día a día?      Gestionar y desarrollar equipos multidisciplinares, promoviendo el compromiso y la orientación a resultados.   Interlocución del servicio con el cliente, construyendo una relación basada en la confianza y la consecución de objetivos.   Analizar los principales indicadores de negocio y operación, detectando tendencias, desviaciones y oportunidades.   Diseñar y poner en marcha planes de acción y mejora continua.   Liderar reuniones de seguimiento y presentar resultados, conclusiones y propuestas de evolución.   Revisar y optimizar procesos, dimensionamientos y modelos operativos para mejorar la eficiencia del servicio.   Participar en la planificación y valoración económica de nuevas necesidades, iniciativas y evolutivos.   Impulsar la incorporación de soluciones digitales y tecnológicas aplicadas al Contact Center.   Trabajar con herramientas de analítica, Business Intelligence y cuadros de mando para facilitar la toma de decisiones.   Coordinar proyectos orientados a mejorar la experiencia de cliente, calidad y productividad.   Asegurar el correcto cumplimiento de los procedimientos y estándares establecidos para la prestación del servicio.   Identificar nuevas oportunidades que permitan aportar mayor valor al cliente y evolucionar la operación.     ¿Qué ofrecemos?      Jornada de trabajo de 9:00 a 18:00 horas de Lunes a Jueves y los Viernes de 9 a 17 h   Convenio Contact Center y Categoría Responsable de Servicio   Salario en función de valía del candidato   Proyecto estable dentro de una compañía consolidada y en crecimiento.   Portal de beneficios y descuentos para empleados.     ¿Te interesa el reto?    Únete a Servinform y participa en proyectos en los que la tecnología y el talento de las personas marcan la diferencia.   ** Ningún sector de nuestra sociedad puede ser entendido sin la igualdad entre hombres y mujeres, así como la integración de las personas con discapacidad.

title: Customer Success Manager – HR & Talent Advisor
location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: At Assessio, our mission is   Zero Talent Waste  . Through our assessment solutions and TalentSuite platform, we help organisations make better decisions across recruitment, talent management and employee development. Today, more than 2,000 organisations use Assessio, and we are continuing to grow across Europe.   We are now looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Danish team in Copenhagen.    The role   As Customer Success Manager, you will join our Danish Customer Success team of three CSMs, working with customers across different industries and organisations of varying sizes. You will own and develop your own portfolio of Danish customers and be responsible for their journey with Assessio, from onboarding and adoption to expansion and renewal.  This role is about more than maintaining great relationships. We want you to become a trusted and consultative partner to your customers. Someone who understands their HR and Talent challenges, asks the right questions and helps translate our solutions into real business value. title: Service Manager
description: ISS är ett av världens största tjänsteföretag och i år firar vi 80 år i Sverige! Med över 6500 medarbetare i landet, från norr till söder, levererar vi service som gör skillnad. Vi erbjuder våra kunder allt från städning till teknisk service, mat- och arbetsplatstjänster. Vi skapar arbetsplatser där människor trivs, företag växer och där hållbarhet är en självklarhet – socialt, miljömässigt och affärsmässigt. Våra medarbetare är hjärtat i det vi gör – och avgörande för att våra kunder ska känna sig trygga, sedda – och för att deras arbetsplatser ska blomstra.     Vi växer och behöver nu stärka upp teamet i Stockholm med en Service Manager!   Till vår verksamhet för mellanstora kunder i Stockholm söker vi på ISS en serviceinriktad och engagerad Service Manager som vill utveckla människor och kundernas verksamhet. Vi erbjuder dig en utmanande roll i ett bolag och bransch under ständig utveckling! Som SMR har du ekonomiskt ansvar och personalansvar för ditt driftområde.     I rollen som SMR ansvarar du vidare för de lokala kundrelationerna och att arbetet bedrivs i enlighet med gällande kundavtal. I samarbete med kund strävar du efter ständiga förbättringar och utveckling av ISS leverans. Här har du stora möjligheter att lyfta leveransen från att vara bra till att bli en av ISS bästa siter!     För oss på ISS är ledarskap viktigt. Genom ditt goda ledarskap förväntas du skapa förutsättningar för dina medarbetare att kunna utvecklas och prestera. Som Service Manager har du direktansvar för 50 medarbetare, varav 2 driftledare. Du leder verksamheten mot uppsatta mål i nära samarbete med kunden, medarbetare och närmaste chef.    Du ansvarar för att verksamheten är optimalt dimensionerad och bemannad. Dessutom är du inte rädd för att själv kliva in i den dagliga driften för att stötta dina medarbetare när så behövs. Att arbetet bedrivs i överensstämmelse med lagar och övriga avtal samt ISS policys och värderingar är en självklarhet för dig.     Du har din bas ute på siterna, och sitter med i regionsledningsgruppen tillsammans med 7 andra Service Manager.     Tjänsten är på heltid och tillsvidareanställning med start så snart som möjligt, samt med en inledande provanställning i sex månader.     Vi erbjuder      Du kommer att arbeta nära kompetenta medarbetare som du får stort utbyte av, då vi värnar om att hjälpa och utveckla varandra. ISS storlek och breda tjänsteutbud bidrar till att det finns goda utvecklingsmöjligheter såväl nationellt som globalt. Vårt fokus ligger i att ta hand om och utveckla våra medarbetare, för vi tror på att ”People make places”. ISS erbjuder bland annat utbildningar och utvecklingsmöjligheter – allt för att du ska engageras och växa med ISS på lång sikt.    Vi värderar mån

Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation — building platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation. title: (Senior) Collection Merchandiser Shoes (f/m/d)
description:
What you will do:

As the (Senior) Collection Merchandiser for the Shoes category, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of the footwear assortment. 

This role requires a deep understanding of luxury fashion, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to drive innovation while maintaining the brand's identity. You will work closely with the design, product development, sales, marketing, and operations teams to create a cohesive and successful shoe collection that meets the needs of both direct-to-consumer (D2C) and business-to-business (B2B) channels.

Assortment Strategy:

  • Develop and implement a long-term assortment strategy for the Shoes category, aligning with the brands product vision and catering to the unique requirements of D2C and B2B channels.
  • Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and consumer insights to inform strategic decision-making.
Collection Creation:
  • Lead the seasonal collection creation process for Shoes, working in close partnership with the design and product development teams.
  • Ensure the collection reflects the brand's DNA, resonates with target customers, and meets commercial objectives.
  • Own the range and the line plan and ensure they are constantly updated.
Critical Path Management:
  • Own the critical path for the Shoes category, ensuring all key milestones and deadlines are met.
  • Schedule and coordinate all relevant meetings, ensuring appropriate stakeholders are involved and prepared.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns and product stories that enhance the visibility and desirability of the Shoes category.
  • Work with sales teams to gather feedback from wholesale partners and clients, ensuring their needs are reflected in the assortment.

title: Growth Manager – Short-Form Content (Instagram & TikTok)
description:
Headquarters:  Schwyz, Switzerland
      URL:   http://xo-angels.com 
 

 We're XO Angels, a creator management agency. As a Growth Manager, you'll own the short-form strategy of 2-4 creators end to end: scripts, shot lists, feedback to creators and editors, and constant testing until the numbers move. Your only real goal: views that turn into real reach. 
  What you'll actually do  
 
 Analyse viral short-form content, understand why it worked, and adapt it for our creators. 
 Write scripts and shot lists that your creators then shoot. Give them precise feedback on what worked, what didn't, and what needs to change. 
 Direct editors and posters. You own the output, they execute it. 
 Analyse every post: why did this hit, why did that flop, what do we double down on this week. 
 Test bold ideas fast, kill what doesn't work, scale what does. 
 
  Who we're looking for 
This is not a 9-to-5. When a Reel goes viral on a Sunday night, you're on it. When an account gets banned at 10pm on a weekday, you handle it. Weekends are normally off, but when there's an emergency you step in, no discussion. If that puts you off, this role isn't for you. 
  We want:  
 
 Obsession with short-form. You watch TikTok and Reels for hours voluntarily and can explain why a video works. You're not learning this, you already live it. 
 Ownership mindset. You treat your creators' accounts like your own business. No excuses, no "the editor didn't deliver", you make it happen. 
 Analytical eye. You can look at 20 videos and tell us what pattern connects the winners. 
 Fluent English. Non-negotiable. 
 Bonus, not required: experience growing IG or TikTok accounts, agency or marketing background. We care more about drive and taste than about your CV. 
 
  What you get  
 
 3,000 USD base + performance bonuses. Realistic total 3,500-7,000 USD/month depending on results. 
 100% remote. Work from wherever. 
 Direct impact. Small team, no bureaucracy. Your ideas ship this week, not next quarter. 
 Clear path up. If you really push, you can become Head of Marketing within 12-18 months and lead your own team. 
 
  How to apply 
Click the link and fill out the short application. It tells you honestly what the role really involves, and screens you in or out, so neither you nor we waste any time. 
   https://forms.gle/fyJijS45f1nT2x8Z7

About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

Synthesia Roleplay Sessions is a training tool that lets people practice real conversations with AI avatars. Arbeitssprache: Deutsch

Was wir lösen

Die Energiewende ist relevanter denn je: Solaranlagen, Wärmepumpen und Wallboxen werden in Deutschland so schnell gebaut wie noch nie. Aber es gibt eine Bremse, die kaum jemand kennt - Bürokratie.

Was heißt das konkret? Jede einzelne Anlage muss beim Netzbetreiber angemeldet werden, bevor sie laufen darf.
Klingt einfach? Ist es nicht: In Deutschland gibt es über 850 Netzbetreiber - jeder mit eigenen Formularen, eigenen Prozessen, eigener Auslegung der Regeln. Kein Standard.
Für Installationsbetriebe heißt das drei bis vier Stunden pro Anlage, in denen ein Handwerker Formulare ausfüllt statt zu bauen.

Wir lösen das mit Software. Unsere Plattform erzeugt die Unterlagen aus den Daten des Installateurs und reicht sie automatisiert beim richtigen Netzbetreiber ein.
Unter unseren Kunden sind die größten Player der Solar- und Wärmepumpenbranche in Europa.
Und weil dieses Problem den Installationsbetrieben so weh tut, konnten wir im letzten Jahr von null auf über 1 Mio. € Umsatz gewachsen - bootstrapped, profitabel und ohne Investorengeld.

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest im operativen Kern unseres Produkts und trägst Ownership für einen ganzen Bereich.
Dort sorgst du dafür, dass alles sauber durchläuft: Du behandelst die Edge Cases, kommunizierst mit allen relevanten Stakehold

title: Backend Engineer (Golang) - Transfers EU
description:
At SumUp, we empower small businesses with simple, affordable tools to start, run, and grow. Our Global Bank teams build the financial services that help merchants manage their money and keep their businesses moving.

As a Backend Engineer, you'll take ownership of services that process real money. You'll work on complex systems problems to ensure seamless integrations as we scale, while seeing a direct connection between your engineering decisions and merchant trust.

If you enjoy understanding how systems behave under real-world conditions while improving them over time, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll do 

  • Build and maintain production money movement backend services, contributing to their delivery, observability, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Own and deliver well‑defined tasks and features, and contribute to larger projects within the team's domain.
  • Contribute to technical design and implementation, following established architectural patterns and best practices.

description: La Dona, CRM înseamnă relații pe termen lung cu milioane de pacienți.      Căutăm un CRM & Customer Growth Manager care să construiască și să ducă la maturitate strategia de CRM și loialitate, într-un ecosistem O2O real (online + farmacii).  Obiectivul este clar: creșterea retenției, a frecvenței de vizită în farmacii și a valorii pe termen lung a pacienților, cu impact direct și măsurabil în performanța comercială.      Responsabilități principale:    Definește și implementează strategia de CRM și loialitate Dona, aliniată cu obiectivele comerciale.  Utilizează datele de comportament ale clienților pentru segmentare avansată (RFM, segmentare valorică).  Concepe, implementează și optimizează campanii CRM targetate (SMS, email, push).  Definește structura ofertelor și beneficiilor de loialitate pe baza datelor, evitând discounturile în masă.  Lucrează hands-on cu platformele CRM și canalele de Comunicare.  Colaborează cu echipele de Marketing, IT, E-commerce și Retail.  Monitorizează KPIs de business (retenție, frecvență, CLV, uplift vânzări) și propune optimizări.  Propune decizii bazate pe date și le susține argumentat în discuțiile interne.       Cerințe:    Minimum 3–5 ani activitate în zona de CRM, loialitate sau customer analytics.  Track record demonstrat în rularea campaniilor CRM end-to-end, inclusiv lecții învățate din inițiative care nu au performat.  Experiență în coordonarea unei echipe și gestionarea unui buget dedicate.  Familiaritate practică cu platforme CRM (Charisma CRM, Salesforce, The Marketer sau similare).  Abilități solide de analiză (Excel avansat; SQL / Power BI / Tableau – avantaj).  Confort într-un rol hands-on.  Gândire structurată, orientare spre rezultat și asumare. Ce oferim:    Un rol cu vizibilitate ridicată și expunere directă la decizii comerciale strategice.  Sistem de bonusare corelat cu performanța și rezultatele comerciale.  Tichete de masa.  Tichete cadou de Paște și Crăciun.  Asigurare privată de sănătate.  Card de reducere în Farmaciile DONA.  Discounturi la diverși parteneri.       Descrierea companiei   Grupul DONA este unul dintre cele mai mari si dinamice grupuri farmaceutice din Romania, avand o  cifra de afaceri anuala de peste 800 de milioane de euro.    Cu o traditie de  peste 30 de ani  pe piata farmaceutica romaneasca, Farmaciile Dona sunt astazi printre cele mai apreciate din tara. Avand capital 100% romanesc, se dedica oferirii de servicii de sanatate de cea mai inalta calitate.  Alaturi de o echipa de aproximativ 2 500 de profesionisti , Grupul DONA pune pasiune, etica si excelenta in tot ceea ce face.

title: Customer Service Lead
description: Rathbones Tailor is an online formalwear hire business. Customers book suits, morning wear and Highland wear through our store, wear them for their event, and send them back. We have been trading for five years, the last eighteen months on our current Shopify site, and have completed over ten thousand rentals.       Customer service is where this business lives or dies. A hire order is a promise: the right outfit, on time, a good fit, an easy return. Get that right and customers come back and tell people. Get it wrong and they remember. That is why we treat CS as a function to lead properly, not a queue to clear.       Why this role exists       This role steps in to lead our customer service function and own it outright. You are the person the rest of the team brings a CS question to, and the one accountable for how customers are looked after from first enquiry to final return.       This is a lead role in the fullest sense. The systems work today, but "work" is a low bar. We want someone to come in, understand how customers actually move through a hire, and rebuild the CS operation so it is faster, calmer and less dependent on any one person. You will not be handed a finished playbook to follow. You will write it.       We are actively looking to put new tools and AI to work here. A large share of our contact is repetitive and predictable, which is exactly the kind of load that automation and AI-assisted support can take off a person's plate. We want someone who is hungry to build that, not wary of it: someone who will automate the routine so the human time goes to the cases that actually need judgement.       The shape of the job       You own three things:       1. Run the function. Own the customer inbox and the full lifecycle of a hire enquiry: pre-order sizing and fit questions, order status (WISMO), exchanges and size swaps, delivery issues, returns, and late-return chasing. Hit response and resolution targets across the trading calendar, including our summer and pre-Christmas peaks.       2. Build the systems, lean on AI. Diagnose where the current process leaks time or goodwill and fix it. That means macros and templates that actually match our situations, clean escalation paths, and documentation that lets a new joiner pick things up in a day rather than a month. Above all it means using automation and AI to take the repetitive volume off people: an AI-assisted triage and response layer for high-volume queries (order status, size swaps, late returns) so the team spends its time on the cases that need a human. You will have real say over the tooling and be expected to make the case for it and put it live.       3. Lead it, and keep the Director in the loop. You run this function so it is genuinely handled, not watched over. A short weekly update and a fuller monthly one keep the Director across the numbers, the wins, the pain points and anything that needs a decision at his level. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role where you’ll work directly with key strategic customer accounts, ensuring high levels of service and commercial alignment.     You’ll build and nurture strong relationships with our strategic partners, becoming a trusted point of contact who drives collaboration and long-term value. You’ll also work closely with the Customer Operations Manager to support the team’s daily performance and continuous improvement. Ensure smooth order placement and delivery, using exception reports to identify and resolve issues promptly.  Manage in-season order requests and prioritise fulfilment to meet commercial and customer needs. Proactive problem-solver who can lead by example and bring structure and clarity to daily operations.  Proven experience in a customer-facing or account management role, ideally within a supply chain or commercial operations environment.  Strong communication skills and a customer-first mindset, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. title: Fractional RevOps / GTM Engineer (Part-Time, Contract)
description:
Anagram is the ultimate insurance billing platform for eye care providers. Combining instant eligibility and benefit verifications, patient responsibility calculation, claims management, payment posting, and more, Anagram's all-in-one revenue cycle management solution is designed to save providers time and money, and free doctors to deliver the best care for their patients. Our mission is to simplify insurance, and it's working: over 2,000 eye care professionals rely on Anagram to manage their insurance billing.

Founded in 2014, Anagram is the largest and fastest-growing insurance billing platform for eye care providers in America and processes hundreds of millions of dollars each year.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on RevOps/GTM engineer to own the revenue systems layer across a genuinely messy and interesting go-to-market. You'll design and maintain the pipes connecting CRM, billing, warehouse, and analytics, and wire AI into the workflows in between. You'll work directly with revenue leadership and have wide latitude in how things get built.

Why This Role Is Harder Than It Sounds

  • The account hierarchy is real. Our market spans solo practices, multi-location companies, roll-up brands, and PE platforms. The HubSpot company object has to do quadruple duty — PE firm → brand → company → location — with clean parent-child associations, dedup logic that respects the hierarchy, and reporting that rolls up correctly at every level.

  • Four GTM motions run in parallel. SMB, mid-market, enterprise, and partner led — each needs its own routing, lifecycle logic, handoffs, and funnel reporting, without forking the CRM into four incompatible systems.

  • Three products, three pricing models. Subscription, usage-based, and percentage-of-collections billing all flow through the same revenue stack. Normalizing these into coherent ARR/NRR, cohort, and revenue reporting is a core design problem, not an afterthought.

About You

  • You're a hands-on RevOps/GTM engineer with a builder profile.

  • Strong SQL from scratch.

  • You know when a Zap is enough and when it's time to write code.

  • Self-directed; comfortable operating fractionally with async communication and minimal oversight.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 4+ years in RevOps, GTM engineering, or sales/marketing ops with a builder profile

  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience custom objects, associations, workflows, API —ideally with complex parent-child account structures (multi-location, franchise, healthcare, or roll-up environments)

  • Production experience with Stripe data, including usage-based or non-standard billing models

  • Production experience with Zapier<

title: Customer Success Manager

Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor jou!     Wij zijn namelijk op zoek naar een Customer Success Manager.      Over Dynamic People      Geen standaard club, geen standaard projecten. We zijn een hecht team van consultants, developers en strategen die werken met de nieuwste Microsoft-technologieën. Samen bouwen we slimme oplossingen voor complexe vraagstukken.     Met onze diepgaande businesskennis en expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (ERP & CRM), Power Platform, Azure, Data en AI, begeleiden we organisaties van strategie tot en met implementatie en beheer.     Onze cultuur? Ondernemend, gedreven en wij werken samen. We vieren successen samen en geloven dat onze mensen het verschil maken. Je begrijpt de ambities van de klant, vertaalt deze naar concrete oplossingen en services en zorgt ervoor dat klanten blijvend waarde halen uit hun Dynamics 365-omgeving.     Je voert strategische gesprekken, ontwikkelt klant-roadmaps en brengt als regisseur de juiste mensen samen om kansen te realiseren. Je bent regelmatig bij klanten aanwezig, werkt ook vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam en werkt nauw samen met Sales, Marketing, Managed Services, Delivery en Microsoft om gezamenlijk klantdoelstellingen te realiseren.     Jij zorgt ervoor dat klanten niet alleen tevreden zijn, maar echte ambassadeurs van Dynamic People worden.      Wat ga je doen?       Je bouwt aan sterke relaties met klanten en bent hun vertrouwde adviseur.  Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt klant-roadmaps gericht op groei en innovatie.  Je identificeert nieuwe kansen voor upsell, cross-sell en aanvullende dienstverlening.  Je initieert, regisseert en werkt actief mee aan offertes, business cases en pre sales trajecten.  Je organiseert kennissessies, workshops en strategische overleggen.  Je verzamelt klantfeedback en vertaalt deze naar verbeteringen binnen onze dienstverlening.       Wat breng jij mee?       Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Customer Succes Manager, Account Manager, Consultant of een vergelijkbare klantgerichte rol.  Kennis van Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, ERP, Power Platform, Dataplatformen en ontwikkelingen op AI-gebied houd je bij.  Kennis van CPQ producten en de wereld van Commodity Traders is mooi meegenomen.  Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op verschillende niveaus.  Een commerciële mindset en het vermogen om kansen te herkennen én te verzilveren.  Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om klanten mee te nemen in een visie en roadmap.       Je bent:       Ondernemend en proactief.  Van nature een relatiebouwer

title: Customer Success Manager Legal Tech
description: Lefebvre Sdu is misschien wel de oudste AI-startup van Nederland. Niet omdat we voorop lopen in technologie, maar omdat we de kennis hebben waar die technologie op draait. Die bouwen we al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat is niet te kopiëren. Als Nederlands hart van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, bouwen we GenIA-L: een AI-platform waarop juristen en fiscalisten niet zomaar een antwoord krijgen, maar een antwoord waar ze hun naam onder durven te zetten. Meer dan 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, goed voor ruim 100 miljoen euro ARR in Europa. We zoeken iemand die zorgt dat ze het ook echt anders gaan doen.      HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT   Een licentie afsluiten is één ding. Een kantoor zijn werkproces laten herzien rond AI is iets anders. Juristen en fiscalisten werken zoals ze werken omdat het al jaren zo gaat, en een nieuw platform verandert daar uit zichzelf niets aan. Iemand moet naast ze gaan zitten, kijken hoe hun dossierwerk er nu uitziet en laten zien waar GenIA-L dat werk overneemt of versnelt. Daarvoor moet je dat werk zelf hebben gedaan. Jij hebt jaren in de praktijk gestaan. Je weet hoe een dossier wordt opgebouwd, waar de uren in gaan zitten en waarom een professional niet zomaar vertrouwt op een antwoord dat hij niet kan narekenen. Die geloofwaardigheid is je belangrijkste instrument: wanneer jij tegenover een partner zit, praat je met iemand uit hetzelfde vak. Je bent daarmee de belangrijkste ambassadeur van het product, naar buiten én naar binnen. Wat jij bij klanten ziet, breng je terug, want de beste roadmap-input komt van mensen die het platform elke dag proberen te gebruiken.      Je begeleidt klanten van livegang tot volwassen gebruik, en je stuurt op adoptie in plaats van op tevredenheid.  Je analyseert de werkprocessen van juridische en fiscale teams en vertaalt die naar een concrete inrichting van GenIA-L.  Je traint gebruikers en interne key users, zodat kennis over het platform bij de klant blijft.  Je meet gebruik, signaleert waar adoptie stokt en grijpt in voordat een verlenging in gevaar komt.  Je bouwt aan een aanpak die herhaalbaar is: playbooks, use cases en voorbeelden die je bij de volgende klant weer inzet.  Je brengt de praktijk van de klant terug naar product en redactie, en je bent de stem van de gebruiker in onze eigen ontwikkeling.  Je werkt nauw samen met sales, zodat uitbreiding en verlenging voortkomen uit gebruik dat aantoonbaar waarde oplevert.       DIT ZOEKEN WIJ   Je bent commercieel sterk en op het punt gekomen waarop je meer wilt dan alleen verkopen. Je hebt gezien wat AI met de manier waarop organisaties werken gaat doen en je wilt aan die kant van de tafel zitten, bij de partij die het bouwt in plaats van bij de partij die het over zich heen krijgt. Je commerciële ervaring neem je mee, maar je wilt dichter op de klant, het product en de impact zitten.   Ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol in customer success, business

Jouw bijdrage aan onze missie      Als Customer Experience Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en consistentie van de totale customer experience. Van digitale tot persoonlijke interacties: jij bewaakt de kwaliteit van alle processen die onze customer journey direct raken. Daarom zoeken we iemand die over de hele organisatie heen kijkt, ontdekt waar het beter kan en ervoor zorgt dat verbeteringen ook daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd.     Jij bent binnen DeWarmte de functionele eigenaar van Customer Experience. Je bepaalt samen met de organisatie wat onze CX-standaard is, brengt systematisch in kaart waar we daar niet aan voldoen en zorgt dat de belangrijkste verbeteringen daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd. Je werkt hiervoor dwars door Marketing, Sales, Operations, Installation, Support & Service en Software heen.     Je hoeft daarbij niet ieder project zelf uit te voeren. Een verbetering kan bij jou liggen, bij een ‘Head of’ of bij iemand anders in de organisatie. Wat wél bij jou blijft liggen, is de accountability voor het realiseren van de verbetering: je zorgt voor een duidelijke eigenaar, doelstelling, deadlines en een kwaliteitsstandaard. Daarnaast bewaak je de voortgang en het resultaat. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de CEO. Vanuit die positie werk je organisatiebreed en krijg je het mandaat om CX-verbeteringen over teams heen aan te jagen. Cross-functionele verbeterprojecten die over meerdere teams heen lopen, leid je in principe zelf.     Dat vraagt senioriteit. Je moet een Head kunnen challengen wanneer de customer experience niet goed genoeg is, maar net zo makkelijk zelf een review beantwoorden, een geautomatiseerde e-mail herschrijven of een (kleiner) verbeterproject van A tot Z uitvoeren.      Wat ga je doen?       Je beheert en verbetert onze bestaande customer journey en bijbehorende process maps en gebruikt deze om continu te identificeren waar de customer experience beter kan.  Je ontwikkelt samen met de verschillende teams onze CX-standaarden voor de belangrijkste customer touchpoints, bewaakt deze en spreekt teams erop aan wanneer de ervaring daar niet aan voldoet.  Je gebruikt reviews, klachten, customer feedback en operationele data om structurele problemen en verbeterkansen te identificeren en te prioriteren.  J

Polismyndigheten är Sveriges största myndighet med ca 40 000 medarbetare över hela landet. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra till Polisens uppdrag – att öka tryggheten och minska brottsligheten i samhället.  Operativa enhetens uppdrag är att aktivt stödja lokalpolisområden, polisområden och enheter i sitt grunduppdrag. Detta görs genom att utveckla och tillhandahålla specialistförmåga som höjer den operativa effekten i arbetet med regionens problembild. Med specialistkompetens, hög service och god samverkan är operativa enheten en viktig del i det operativa och brottsbekämpande arbetet i region Bergslagen.  Polisens kontaktcenter (PKC) återfinns inom den operativa enheten på regionnivå och är för många första mötet med polismyndigheten. PKC har ca 90 anställda. Sektionen består av 7 grupper som är fördelade i Falun och Karlstad. Vårt uppdrag handlar om att vara det första steget i en effektiv och kvalitetssäkrad brottsutredningsprocess med fokus på brottsuppklarning och brottsofferbemötande. Polisens kontaktcenter har i dag som uppgift att ta emot anmälningar, tips och lämna upplysningar till allmänheten. Dessutom är polisens kontaktcenter en viktig del i den initiala utredningsprocessen och i polisens arbete med att lösa brott. PKC har ett utökat uppdrag i utredningsprocessen, vilket innebär att tidiga beslut fattas för att kunna vidta de initiala utredningsåtgärderna som är relevanta och tidskritiska. Arbetet ska syfta till att avgöra om ärendet är utredningsbart och på så sätt minska ärendebelastningen på lokalpolisområdena samt ge medborgarna en tidig prognos i sitt ärende.  Arbetsbeskrivning  Som chef för PKC rapporterar du till sektionschef samt ingår i sektionens ledningsgrupp, där ni tillsammans ansvarar för att uppdrag genomförs samt att driva myndighetens förändrings- och utvecklingsarbete. Du har särskilt ansvar för gruppens verksamhet inom service- och utredningsuppdraget och dess resultat. Som gruppchef företräder du hela Polismyndigheten både internt och externt samt arbetar för att stärka förtroendet för polisverksamheten. Som gruppchef ingår det att inneha ett tillikauppdrag. Antigen i rollen som operativ ledare PKC, med ansvarar för den minutoperativa driften genom att styra verksamheten efter behov. Eller i rollen som förundersökningsledare och hantera initiala utredningsuppgifter.  Att vara chef och ledare inom Polismyndigheten innebär att skapa trygghet och bygga förtroende genom att utöva ett uppriktigt, modigt och lyhört ledarskap med tillit till andras kompetens och förmåga. Som chef driver du utveckling genom att inspirera och uppmuntra till reflektion och återkoppling på ett sätt som utgår från att vi följer lagen och behandlar människor lika. Etsimme joukkoomme  palvelupäällikköä Kiteelle  johtamaan tulosyksikön operatiivista toimintaa ja vastaamaan sen tuloksellisesta kehittämisestä. Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisen palvelukokonaisuuden parissa, johon kuuluvat sähkö-, automaatio-, turvatekniikka-, lukitus- ja LVI-palvelut. Viihdyt varmasti Caverionilla, jos sinulla on:     Tekninen koulutus ja taloteknisen alan osaamista  Kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja hyvät esihenkilötaidot  Myyntihenkinen ja asiakaslähtöinen työote  Hyvät yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot  Valmius työskennellä itsenäisesti ja ottaa vastuuta tulosyksikön toiminnasta  B-ajokortti ja mahdollisuus käyttää omaa autoa työssä  Valmius turvallisuusselvitykseen tarvittaessa     Sähkö- ja automaatioalan osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.   Entä mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?   ✅ Kattavan perehdytyksen työhön ja oman tiimin tuen, laajat koulutus- ja kehitysmahdollisuudet sekä avoimen ja osallistavan työkulttuurin.  ✅ Selkeät tavoitteet, jotka auttavat sinua onnistumaan työssäsi. Palkitsemme hyvästä suorituksesta.  ✅ Laajat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedut.  ✅ Mahdollisuuden työskennellä joustavasti hybridimallimme mukaisesti.  ✅ Yhteen hiileen puhaltavan ja sitoutuneen työyhteisön, joka auttaa sinua kehittymään urallasi. Käy kurkkaamassa Caverikirjasta, millaista meillä on olla töissä.  ✅ Työpaikan, jossa teemme asiat laadukkaasti – ja jossa työturvallisuus on ykkösasia. Meille turvallisuus on kuitenkin paljon muutakin: se on luottamusta, vapautta, uramahdollisuuksia ja inhimillisyyttä kaikissa elämäntilanteissa. Una persona precisa, elegante nella comunicazione, empatica e capace di mantenere standard elevati anche nelle situazioni più complesse. Amiamo ciò che facciamo. title: Client Solutions Manager (AppInToss)
description: [합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요]    토스의 Client Solutions Manager는 앱인토스(Apps in Toss) Foundation Team에 속해 있어요.  앱인토스는 외부 파트너사의 서비스가 토스 앱 안에서 미니앱 형태로 동작하는 플랫폼이에요. 파트너사는 별도의 앱 설치나 회원가입 과정 없이, 토스가 가진 사용자와 인증·결제 인프라를 그대로 활용해 서비스를 제공할 수 있어요.  Foundation Team은 이 플랫폼의 기반을 만들고 운영해요. 파트너사가 미니앱을 개발하고 배포하는 개발자센터와 SDK, 입점 심사와 검수 체계, 수수료 정산까지 파트너의 시작부터 정산까지 이어지는 과정을 담당하고 있어요.  동시에 어떤 파트너를 토스 안으로 데려올지 결정하고 실행하는 소싱과 파트너십도 이 팀이 이끌고 있어요. 카테고리별 타깃 발굴부터 입점 조건 협의, 런칭, 입점 이후 성과 관리까지 파트너의 전 여정을 함께해요.  Foundation Team의 목표는 파트너사가 토스 위에서 실제 사업 성과를 만들어내도록 돕고, 그 결과로 앱인토스가 파트너와 사용자 모두에게 선택받는 플랫폼이 되는 것이에요.    [ 합류하면 함께 할 업무 ]    파트너 발굴 및 입점 제안 — 카테고리별 타깃을 발굴하고, 파트너사의 사업 구조와 핵심 KPI를 파악해 입점 가치를 제안합니다. 토스가 실제로 풀 수 있는 문제인지 적합도를 판단하는 것까지 포함합니다.  입점 설계 및 런칭 — 단계적 출시 범위와 입점 조건을 합의하고, PO·개발·검수·정산 유관팀을 조율해 런칭까지 완결합니다.  입점 파트너 성과 관리 — 다수 파트너를 동시에 맡아 활성화율, 매출, 리텐션을 장기간 관리합니다. 업종과 퍼널 특성에 맞는 활성화 방식과 성과 측정 체계를 직접 설계합니다.  성과 리뷰 기반 확장 — 정기 리뷰를 통해 추가 기능과 지면을 제안하고, 이탈 파트너를 리비짓합니다.  파이프라인 및 시장 관리 — 파트너 포트폴리오 현황을 관리하고, 파트너 VOC와 경쟁 플랫폼 동향을 제품·전략에 반영합니다.    [ 이런 분을 찾고 있어요 ]    고객사의 사업과 KPI를 파악해 핵심 문제를 구조화하고, 그 언어로 제안하시는 분  파트너의 요구를 한 번에 다 받지 않고, 실행 가능한 범위로 잘라 첫 출시를 만들어내시는 분  여러 파트너를 동시에 맡아 지표를 지속 추적하며 성과를 개선해보신 분  업종과 퍼널에 따라 활성화 조건이 다르다는 것을 이해하고, 선행지표를 스스로 정의하시는 분  파트너사의 기획·개발 담당자와 스펙과 연동 방식을 직접 논의할 수 있는 제품 이해도를 갖추신 분    [ 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요 ]    미니앱, 인앱 서비스 형태에 대한 이해를 가지신 분  커머스, O2O, 게임 등 주요 소싱 카테고리 도메인 경험을 하신 분

title: Customer Complaints Senior Manager
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Complaints Senior Manager based in Switzerland.   This is a senior compliance leadership role responsible for a global customer complaints program across multiple jurisdictions.  You’ll oversee the end-to-end complaints framework, ensuring consistent handling, strong governance, regulatory alignment, and effective customer outcomes.  The role combines second-line oversight, quality assurance, conduct-risk analysis, regulatory response coordination, and executive reporting.  You’ll work closely with Compliance, Legal, Customer Support, Product, Operations, and Risk teams across a geographically distributed organization.  A key focus will be transforming complaint data into actionable intelligence by identifying trends, root causes, control gaps, and potential systemic risks.  You’ll also coordinate complex regulatory inquiries and escalated complaints, ensuring responses are accurate, defensible, timely, and appropriately tracked through remediation.  This is an influential opportunity for an experienced compliance professional who can combine strong regulatory judgment with analytical thinking and cross-functional leadership.  Accountabilities    Own and develop the global customer complaints program, establishing consistent standards for complaint identification, classification, investigation, resolution, escalation, documentation, and closed-loop validation.  Coordinate responses to regulatory inquiries, examinations, information requests, escalated complaints, and other supervisory matters in partnership with Legal and local Compliance teams.  Gather and validate cross-functional information, prepare clear and defensible written regulatory responses, manage review and approval processes, meet regulatory deadlines, and track resulting commitments and remediation through closure.  Partner with local Heads of Compliance to monitor jurisdiction-specific regulatory developments and ensure global policies, standards, procedures, and controls remain aligned with applicable local requirements.  Lead second-line oversight and quality assurance through risk-based testing of complaint handling, identification of control gaps and customer-outcome issues, remediation tracking, and escalation of material concerns.  Analyze complaint data to identify trends, recurring issues, overdue cases, regulatory complaints, customer-impact patterns, and potential systemic conduct or compliance risks.  Drive root-cause analysis and systemic remediation, assessing whether broader customer populations may be affected and ensuring appropriate corrective actions are identified and followed through.  Maintain complaints governance, including the complaints management database, service-level requirements, escalation thresholds, documentation standards, and governance processes across regions. title: Patient Experience Manager
description: Saudi German Health -  Madinah Branch  Hiring | Patient Experience Manager      We are looking for an experienced  Patient Experience Manager  to lead and enhance the overall patient journey, ensuring the delivery of a consistently high-quality, patient-centered experience across our healthcare services. title: Team Leader - Nonfood - København S

description: Team Leader – Nonfood   Bliv Teamleader hos Danmarks stærkeste detailkoncept    Er du en engageret leder med passion for kundeservice og medarbejderudvikling? Så bliv en del af Bilka som Teamleader og vær med til at skabe en inspirerende kundeoplevelse og et stærkt team.   Din rolle som teamleader:    Som Teamleader i Bilka har du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse i dit team. Du vil spille en central rolle i at sikre effektiv drift, udvikling af medarbejdere og skabe en inkluderende kultur. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ledelsen og andre afdelinger for at sikre, at teamet lever op til Bilkas standarder og mål. Du får det daglige ansvar for teamets – primært uge – deltidsmedarbejdere. Netop vores ungeindsats ønsker vi at prioritere endnu højere i fremtiden.   Dine ansvarsområder inkluderer:      Daglig ledelse og aktiv deltagelse i Nonfood-teamet   Ansættelse, onboarding og udvikling af medarbejdere.  Planlægning og opfølgning på driftsrutiner og nøgletal.  Sikre en høj standard for kundeservice og produktkvalitet.  Implementere strategiske initiativer og drive egne projekter.     Hvem er du?    Med dine solide ledelseskompetencer skaber du en feedback- og læringskultur i dit team. Du tænker analytisk, har finansiel indsigt og er en dygtig kommunikatør. Du er salgs- og resultatorienteret med et godt kundefokus, samtidig med at du formår at motivere og engagere dine kollegaer.   Vi tilbyder:    En spændende lederrolle, hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle dig selv og dine medarbejdere i et dynamisk miljø. Du vil blive en del af et engageret team, hvor samarbejde og fællesskab er i fokus. Vi tilbyder konkurrencedygtig vilkår og en arbejdsplads, hvor du kan gøre en forskel.  Som ansat i Bilka bliver du en del af Danmarks største detailvirksomhed. Du bliver en del af et stort netværk på tværs af hele koncernen, der bidrager til din fortsatte udvikling. Vi prioriterer din trivsel og tilbyder attraktive medarbejderfordele; herunder rabatter, sundhedsforsikring og fleksible arbejdstider. Hos os får du mulighed for at vokse i din karriere gennem målrettet uddannelse og udviklingsprogrammer. Vi værdsætter diversitet og inklusion, og vi ser frem til at byde dig velkommen i et miljø, der understøtter dine idéer og ambitioner.  Hvis du har det, der skal til, så send os din ansøgning.  Vi frem til at høre fra dig!

title: Palvelupäällikkö
description: Tule meille palvelupäälliköksi Lapin ja Pohjois-Pohjanmaan alueelle!   Haluatko johtaa omaa palvelualueettasi ja vastata asiakkuuksien, henkilöstön ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä? Meillä työ tehdään vastuullisesti osana luotettavaa tiimiä.  Etsimme tavoitteellista ja kehittämisorientoitunutta palvelupäällikköä, joka nauttii ihmisten johtamisesta, asiakastyöstä ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä.  Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnasta kokonaisvaltaisesti. Johdat arjen tekemistä tavoitteellisesti, kehität palvelun laatua ja toimintaa sekä varmistat asiakastyytyväisyyden ja toiminnan kannattavuuden. Samalla huolehdit siitä, että toiminta on sujuvaa, turvallista ja arvojemme mukaista.  Roolissasi toimit keskeisessä asemassa asiakkaiden, henkilöstön ja sisäisten sidosryhmien välillä. Vaikutat suoraan asiakaskokemukseen, henkilöstön onnistumiseen ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisuuteen sekä ja johdat muutosta sekä kehität toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti.  Tehtävässä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnan ja asiakassuhteiden johtamisesta sekä niiden kehittämisestä, laadun ja tehokkuuden varmistamisesta sekä myynnillisestä työotteesta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta. Arjessa johdat henkilöstöä ja tuet työkykyä sekä vastaat talouden, resurssien ja kannattavuuden kokonaisvaltaisesta hallinnasta.   Odotamme sinulta    Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva koulutus, esimerkiksi korkeakoulututkinto. Kokemus esihenkilötehtävistä ja/tai palveluliiketoiminnasta on eduksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä.Ymmärrät talouden tunnuslukuja ja kannattavuuden johtamista. Työskentelet asiakaslähtöisesti ja myynnillisellä otteella, tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja osaat tarjota niihin toimivia ratkaisuja.  Olet vuorovaikutustaitoinen, oikeudenmukainen ja johdonmukainen esihenkilö, joka osaa motivoida, kehittää ja valmentaa tiimiään arjessa. Toiminnassasi korostuvat vastuullisuus, ratkaisukeskeisyys, liiketoimintalähtöinen ajattelu ja kyky johtaa kokonaisuuksia. Haluat myös aktiivisesti edistää yhdenvertaista ja arvostavaa työyhteisöä.  Tehtävä edellyttää voimassa olevaa ajokorttia sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä työssä liikutaan asiakkaiden ja tiimin tarpeiden mukaisesti eri kohteiden välillä laajalla työskentelyalueella.   Tarjoamme sinulle    Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin liiketoiminnan ytimessä sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ja kehittää toimintaa aidosti.  Lisäksi tarjoamme:     kilpailukykyisen palkan n. 3400–3800 €/kk kokemuksesta riippuen   kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen tehtävässä onnistumiseen   mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja rakentaa urapolkuasi kasvavassa organisaatiossa   kansainvälisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön   turvallisen ja arvostavan työympäristön   reilut työehdot, turvallisen työympäristön ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista huolehtimisen    Työskentelemme joustavasti hybridityömallilla ja työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia asiakkaiden ja oman alueen tarpeiden mukaan.   Yhdenvertaisuus ja vastuullisuus   Meille

description: Lead a high-performing national team delivering critical information services  Wellington based with hybrid working arrangements  Permanent leadership opportunity      Make a meaningful difference through leadership in a complex, high-profile operational environment. As Manager Customer Information Requests, you will lead a nationally distributed team responsible for enabling people to access information held by Oranga Tamariki under the Privacy Act and Official Information Act. description:
Über Zenjob

Zenjob ist eine KI-gestützte Plattform für flexible Personallösungen, die seit 2015 Unternehmen und kurzfristig einsatzbereite Mitarbeitende effizient miteinander verbindet. Unternehmen nutzen unsere Buchungsplattform, um Personalbedarf in Echtzeit zu decken, während Studierende unsere Zenjob App nutzen, um Nebenjobs zu finden, die sich optimal mit ihrem Studium vereinbaren lassen. Über 40.000 Zenjobber und 1.000 Partnerunternehmen aus Logistik, Einzelhandel und Gastronomie in allen großen deutschen Städten teilen unseren Glauben daran, dass gute Arbeit kein Zufall ist. Sie ist das Ergebnis innovativer Technologie und echter Leidenschaft. Gute Arbeit beginnt hier.

Über die Rolle

Als Growth Lead (w/m/d) verantwortest du, wie schnell und wie profitabel Zenjob wächst. Du gewinnst beide Seiten unseres Marktplatzes: Talents und Business Kunden. Google und Meta liegen bei dir im Account, nicht im Deck einer Agentur. Du führst ein kleines, schlagkräftiges Team aus Performance und SEO/GEO und packst selbst mit an. Im B2B baust du gemeinsam mit Sales eine planbare Lead-Maschine.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du entwickelst und verantwortest die Performance-Marketing-Strategie für Talents (B2C) und Business Kunden (B2B)

  • Du steuerst Google und Meta hands-on selbst: Account-Struktur, Budget- und Bidding-Logik, Creative-Testing und Skalierung. Google inklusive Search, Performance Max, YouTube und App-Kampagnen

  • Du führst dein Team als People Manager: einen Performance Marketer mit Schwerpunkt TikTok und weitere Paid Social Kanäle sowie zwei SEO/GEO Manager

title: (Senior) DevOps Engineer (F/M/*)
description:
Aus Europa, für Europa - wir entwickeln Europas Business-KI.

Wir sind das größte KI-Start-up in Aachen.

KMUs profitieren davon, wenn internes Wissen sofort nutzbar wird und intelligente Agenten darauf reagieren können. Wir glauben an eine Zukunft, in der Business-KI, einschließlich Agenten innerhalb von amber und anderen Plattformen, auf einer gemeinsamen Kontextschicht arbeitet, sodass Teams schneller arbeiten, Übergaben nahtlos erfolgen und das Know-how im Unternehmen bleibt.

Fragst Du Dich bei der Arbeit ständig: „Wie können wir unsere Infrastruktur noch effizienter gestalten?“ - Dann hilf uns, unsere systemübergreifende KI-Plattform auf die nächste Stufe zu heben. Wir suchen eine:n (Senior) DevOps Engineer, der die Leidenschaft und das Know-how mitbringt, unsere Plattform noch stabiler und skalierbarer weiterzuentwickeln.

 

Aufgaben

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Automatisierung unseres Produkts und unserer Setup Prozesse, um manuellen Workload bei amber zu reduzieren

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Development Team zusammen, um tägliche Deployments neuer Softwareversionen und die Behebung technischer Probleme zu optimieren

  • Du konzipierst, implementierst und dokumentierst die Verbesserung unserer Security Maßnahmen für unsere Kunden sowie für externe Audits

  • Du hast jederzeit ein Auge auf unsere Incident Response, arbeitest an der Root-cause Ana

title: (Senior) Business Development Representative France (f/m/d)
description:
About Zeit AI

Zeit AI builds ZeitMind, the autonomous data engineer for the European mid-market. We connect to the systems companies already run (ERP exports, CRM data, spreadsheets, internal databases) and put agents on top so operators get reliable answers without hiring a data team. Founded by Marvin and Leopold (both ex-Palantir), YC S24, backed by Oxford Seed Fund and Sequoia Scout. Customers across manufacturing, agriculture, and aviation. Zero to €1M ARR in our first twelve months with six people, and doubling every six months.

What this role is

As our Business Development Representative for France, you'll open the French market with us: building our outbound engine there and turning it into real customer opportunities.

Cold calling is how we won our first customers, and it's still our strongest channel.
You'll be the first point of contact for prospects: identifying pain points, generating leads, and converting interest into real opportunities. Within weeks, you'll run your own discovery calls and define use cases directly with C-level prospects.

This role is a fast track into sales.

Outbound experience? You'll move to (Junior) AE in 3-6 months.
New to sales? Same path - your ramp speed sets the pace.

We invest in you with daily coaching, clear targets, uncapped upside. You won't be handed a list and left alone – we grow together.

What you will do

  • Outbound Execution: Run high-velocity outbound with cold calling as your primary channel, backed by email and LinkedIn cadences where they add value

  • Qualification: Assess real pain, urge

title: Werkstudent AI Engineering (m/w/d)
description:
Prozesse verstehen. Lösungen bauen, die bei KMUs tatsächlich laufen.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt

Wir sind ein kleines Team in Neumarkt und entwickeln IoT-Cloud-Lösungen für Maschinen- und Fahrzeughersteller. Parallel bauen wir eine Automatisierungsplattform, mit der wir Prozesse automatisieren – für uns selbst und für unsere Kunden. Mit KI-Agenten, LLM-Anbindungen und der Integration bestehender Fachsysteme.

Der Bedarf ist größer als das, was wir nebenbei erledigen können. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der genau daran arbeitet: bestehende Prozesse aufnehmen, verstehen wo es klemmt, und dann eine Lösung bauen, die läuft.

Was wir nicht suchen: jemanden, der Konzepte schreibt, die niemand umsetzt. Und keine Forschungsprojekte. Unsere Lösungen müssen zu einem Mittelständler passen – also einfach genug, dass sie auch ohne dich weiterlaufen.

Aufgaben

Was du machst

  • Prozesse aufnehmen. Du sprichst mit den Menschen, die einen Prozess täglich durchlaufen – bei uns oder beim Kunden. Du hältst fest, wie er heute wirklich läuft (nicht, wie er laut Handbuch laufen sollte), wo Zeit verloren geht und was am Ende besser sein soll.
  • Konzipieren. Du entscheidest, welcher Teil sich automatisieren lässt, wo KI echten Mehrwert bringt und wo eine einfache Regel genügt. Du schätzt Aufwand und Nutzen ab und legst dem Prozessowner eine Empfehlung vor – keine Optionsliste.
  • Umsetzen, hands-on. Du baust die Lösung selbst: KI-Agenten auf Basis von LLM-APIs, Automatisierungs-Workflows, Anbindung bestehender Systeme über REST-Schnittstellen und Webhooks, dazu die nötige Datenaufbereitung. Und ein Skript in Python oder JavaScript, wo Klicken nicht reicht.
  • Review und Übergabe. Du gehst mit dem Prozessowner durch, ob die Lösung im Alltag hält. Du prüfst nach, dokumentierst so, dass eine andere Person daran weiterarbei

title: Customer Success Application Engineer (Japan)
description:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

Through compassionate, individualized care, a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

Our Sales Representatives are dedicated to guiding clients toward financial freedom. Hungry and motivated sales professionals have full control to maximize their incomes beyond these averages.

  • Motivated individual who enjoys exceeding quotes and working in a fast-paced environment
  • Sale experience required
  • Financial Services experience is a plus

About The Opportunity

We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows.

  • Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language

  • Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary).

Wir wollen die lautesten Handpulled Noodles Europas werden. Dafür fehlt uns die Person, die das kreativ führt.

title: Talent Partner (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description

We build the operating system for renewables: more than 10 GW across 8,000+ plants run on the Amperecloud Platform. Growing that requires energy expertise, and it requires exceptional people. Finding them, developing them and keeping them is what this role exists for.

As

Talent Partner (m/f/d) you work directly with our founders. You own everything talent: who we hire, how we assess, how people grow, and the culture all of it runs on.

Lead: Frederik (CEO) & Florian Strunck (COO)

Contract type: Full-time, permanent

Start: October/November
Location: Berlin

#The role

The focus is singular: talent density and the culture that sustains it. You make sure the few people we hire are exceptional, that our strong people stay and grow, and that our values remain a working standard rather than a poster.

Within that focus, you are the third voice beside the founders on people decisions: who we hire, who we promote, who we bet on, when we part ways. You read people precisely, see early where they are heading, and say it out loud in the room where it counts. No process replaces that; ours is built to support it.

The same logic extends beyond the founders: to our decision-makers you are an advisor, not an order-taker. You read the talent market and tell them what their plans will cost, you sharpen how we present ourselves to candidates, and you build pipelines for the roles we will need before we need them.

You will not start from zero. Over the past year we built our People Guild: values translated into observable behaviors, a leveling framework with Berlin salary bands, structured interviews with an independent bar raiser who holds a veto, a lean feedback cycle. You inherit the engine mid-build, documented, with deadlines and founder sponsorship. You finish it, run it, and make it yours.
