description: Customer Engagement Manager – Physical Access Control Systems     Location: Doha, Qatar     Company Profile:-     IDCUBE is a global provider of intelligent physical Access Control and security solutions, empowering organizations to secure people, premises, and operations. Founded in 2005, IDCUBE combines AI, cloud, biometrics, mobile credentials, and advanced identity technologies to deliver scalable and future-ready security solutions. Its flagship Access360 platform integrates access control, identity management, visitor management, digital credentials, attendance, and AI-driven security intelligence into a unified ecosystem. With a strong global footprint across the  USA, UAE, and India , IDCUBE serves enterprises across diverse industries and geographies. With innovation, reliability, open architecture, and customer-centricity at its core, IDCUBE is redefining modern physical security.     Role Summary:-     A customer-facing technology and commercial engagement role responsible for strengthening customer relationships, supporting new business, and growing existing accounts across Qatar.     The role combines consultative technology sales, solution engagement, technical support, and account development, with a strong focus on increasing ARR, SLA, upsell and cross-sell revenue.     Key Responsibilities:-     * Conduct consultative sales pitches, product demonstrations, POCs and site surveys with end customers and System Integrators.  * Support Sales in opportunity development, technical validation, objection handling and deal closures.  * Regularly engage existing end users to understand evolving requirements and identify ARR, SLA, upsell and cross-sell opportunities.  * Act as a trusted technology advisor and recommend appropriate solutions, upgrades and services.  * Support customer deployments, commissioning, training and technical issue resolution when required.  * Build strong relationships with CXOs, security/facility teams, IT teams and System Integrators.  * Maintain customer intelligence, opportunity pipeline and account-growth plans.     Key KPIs     * Revenue and opportunities influenced/closed  * ARR & SLA growth  * Upsell and cross-sell revenue  * Customer meetings, POCs and conversions  * Customer retention and account expansion     Requirements     * 7–10 years’ experience in physical access control, security technology, ELV, presales, technical sales or systems integration.  * Strong customer-facing, presentation and consultative selling skills.  * Technically credible, commercially driven and comfortable engaging senior stakeholders.  * Experience working with System Integrators and enterprise customers.

title: Senior Manager, Visa Government Solutions Commercialization and Delivery
description: About Us   Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.  At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.  Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.   Job Description   The Senior Manager, Visa Government Solutions Commercialization & Delivery is responsible for leading the end-to-end orchestration, governance, readiness, and delivery execution of complex Visa Government Solutions programs.  This role sits at the intersection of implementation, client delivery, technical readiness, solutioning, commercialization, and cross-functional execution. The successful candidate will ensure that government-focused opportunities, signed deals, strategic partnerships, and priority VGS initiatives are translated into structured implementation plans, scalable delivery models, and measurable business outcomes.  The role will partner closely with Visa Government Solutions leadership, regional Sales, Client Services, Product, Technology, Solutioning, Risk, Legal, Government Engagement, Finance, and external ecosystem partners to ensure delivery priorities are clear, risks are actively managed, implementation ownership is documented, and execution remains aligned to client expectations and Visa’s commercial objectives.   Essential Functions   Implementation Orchestration:    Lead end-to-end implementation orchestration for complex VGS programs, ensuring delivery alignment across Client Services, Product, Technology, Sales, Risk, Legal, regional teams, and external partners.  Establish clear ownership, accountability, RACI models, implementation milestones, governance frameworks, and escalation paths across multi-stakeholder delivery programs.  Drive implementation planning, timeline management, issue resolution, risk identification, mitigation planning, and escalation management for complex government programs.      Government Solutions Delivery Readiness     Partner with VGS Sales, Solutioning, Client Success, and Commercialization teams to validate client readiness, solution readiness, technical feasibility, and implementation approach before activation.  Ensure government programs are sufficiently defined before delivery, including scope, dependencies, client expectations, partner roles, technical requirements, and implementation success measures.  Support the transition of signed VGS opportunities and strategic initiatives into structured execution plans that accelerate activation and revenue realization.     Cross-Functional Program Leadership     Coordinate cross-functional execution across VGS, Client Services, Product, Tech

title: Customer Care Manager
description: Position Summary:   The Customer Care Manager is responsible for leading TOD’s customer care function across service, support, and customer-related commercial activities. The role oversees day-to-day customer care operations, including contact center performance, service delivery, account support, issue resolution, and initiatives that contribute to customer satisfaction, retention, and revenue optimization.  This role plays a key part in ensuring that customer interactions are handled efficiently and professionally across all touchpoints, while also identifying opportunities to improve service quality, operational effectiveness, customer loyalty, and commercial outcomes.      Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:    Lead and manage the end-to-end customer care function across customer support, service delivery, and customer account management.  Oversee contact center operations and ensure service levels, quality standards, and response times are achieved.  Drive continuous improvement in customer care processes, workflows, and operating procedures to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction.  Manage customer escalations and ensure timely resolution of complex issues in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders.  Monitor customer feedback, complaints, and service trends to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.  Support retention and revenue-related initiatives through effective management of renewals, upselling opportunities, and customer engagement activities where applicable.  Collaborate with Product, Technology, Marketing, Finance, and other internal teams to improve the overall customer journey and service experience.  Establish and monitor KPIs, dashboards, and reporting related to service performance, customer satisfaction, retention, and team productivity.  Contribute to budget planning and cost control within the customer care function, ensuring efficient use of resources.  Assess operational risks within the function and implement appropriate controls, governance, and mitigation actions.  Lead, coach, and develop the customer care team to ensure high performance, accountability, and a customer-centric culture.  Ensure policies, processes, and customer interactions are aligned with company standards, compliance requirements, and business objectives.       Qualifications       Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, master’s degree is an advantage.  Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in customer care, customer service, customer operations, or contact center management.

title: Technical Success Manager
description: Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day.  Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead.  At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves.  We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them.  Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast   Job D  escription  :   The Technical Success Manager (TSM) is a high-impact customer-facing role for someone who enjoys combining technical depth, customer advocacy, and commercial awareness to help customers get lasting value from cybersecurity technology.  In this role, you will partner with security, IT, and technical stakeholders to turn deployment into meaningful adoption, helping customers embed the platform into daily security operations, reduce risk, and achieve measurable outcomes.  You will work closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, and Renewals, bringing a clear technical view of customer health, adoption progress, risks, and renewal readiness.  This is a hybrid position, with a minimum of 3 days per week in our Milan office or remotely from Rome.   What will I be doing:     Build trusted relationships with customer security and IT teams, understanding their priorities, workflows, and success outcomes.   Create practical technical success plans that help customers adopt the platform, reduce risk, and realise measurable value.   Identify high-value use cases that make the platform part of everyday security operations.   Use product usage, engagement, and health indicators to spot adoption gaps, underutilisation, and retention risks early.   Guide customers through the transition from deployment to active use, accelerating Time-to-Value and reducing handover friction.   Lead mitigation planning for technical blockers, integration challenges, operational gaps, and customer health risks.   Bring clear technical health insights into renewal readiness, QBRs, growth discussions, and account strategy.   Surface technical opportunities that support expansion, upsell, and cross-sell activity in partnership with the Account Executive.   Champion the voice of technical users by ensuring product feedback, risks, and success requirements are visible internally.     W

title: Customer Success Manager
description: What will you do?     Essere il punto di riferimento per i clienti assegnati per i servizi ricorrenti digitali.  Consigliare e sviluppare la visione del cliente, definire chiaramente i risultati aziendali desiderati e creare un success plan.  Essere responsabile del rinnovo e limitare il tasso di abbandono.  Identificare possibili opportunità di pull through (rinnovo, cross e upselling) con gli esperti del Service Digital.  Fornire regolarmente aggiornamenti sui clienti, approfondimenti sui dati, performance / issue trends.  Creare e tenere traccia delle metriche standard del Customer Health Score Metrics.   Costruire, mantenere e sfruttare solide relazioni con i clienti.  Fornire un ciclo di feedback sui potenziali miglioramenti dell'offerta, sulla base dell'adozione da parte dei clienti e degli input diretti.  Garantire la soddisfazione dei clienti.  Guidare l'utilizzo e contribuire ad accelerare il valore del cliente per ogni prodotto/servizio.  Assicurare incontri di follow-up con le vendite del Paese.  Condividere e implementare le best practice per aumentare la realizzazione dei risultati.     What qualifications will make you successful?     Laurea in Ingegneria o discipline tecniche;  Pregressa esperienza in mansioni analoghe;  Buona conoscenza dell'inglese;  Proattività e dinamicità;  Ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali per lavorare in team e con stakeholders diversi, interni ed esterni;  Customer oriented     What's in it for me?     Contratto stabile e opportunità di carriera;  Opportunità di lavorare in un'azienda internazionale e ben strutturata;  Opportunità di formazione su misura per le tue esigenze e obiettivi di carriera;  Opportunità di crescita con percorsi di sviluppo chiari;  Ambiente di lavoro inclusivo con pari opportunità;  Programma Global Family Leave;  Piani di azionariato;  Programmi di Welfare estendibili alla famiglia;  Assicurazione sanitaria     Ready to make an impact? We're excited to meet you — apply now!   At Schneider, we believe that every employee is a talent who deserves equal opportunities. This means you matter. Every individual needs to feel valued, supported, and treated fairly to do their best work.  Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: “We see you. We value you”. It’s more than just pay and benefits- it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed for you to perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential to shine as an impact maker.  Schneider Electric is there when it matters most to you  Our Total Rewards package outlines all the benefits and support you’ll enjoy as part of the Schneider Electric team:  Care for Yourself and Your Family. We ensure you feel secure with benefits that help you and your family thrive: health and life insurance, paid time off, parental and care leave, flexible work options, support for chronic conditions, and confidential counseling for life’s challenges.  Invest and Plan Your Future. We help you plan and invest for the future with competitive pay

title: Service Manager - ERP Solutions
description: Siamo la  Tech Company  leader in Europa che da oltre 45 anni supporta l’innovazione digitale.   Portare il digitale in ogni impresa  è la nostra missione. Come? Mettendo al centro il cliente e diventando il partner di riferimento di professionisti, piccole, medie e grandi aziende  offrendo soluzioni e servizi personalizzati per ottimizzare i processi aziendali , che si tratti di gestire le risorse umane, le relazioni con i clienti, la fatturazione elettronica o i pagamenti digitali.   In ENTERPRISE siamo il partner ideale per le aziende che ambiscono alla trasformazione digitale.  Comprendiamo le sfide di un mercato in continua evoluzione e per questo abbiamo progettato  soluzioni su misura per realtà ambiziose, orientate alla crescita e desiderose di mantenere il pieno controllo delle proprie performance.   Offriamo un supporto completo per ottimizzare le aree chiave di ogni attività, dall'amministrazione e gestione del personale, alle vendite e acquisti, dalla gestione dei progetti alla produzione e logistica.  Unisciti al nostro team, qui potrai affinare le tue competenze, partecipando a progetti stimolanti e crescendo in ambito ERP,  con l'obiettivo di garantire la soddisfazione del cliente nella fase di post-vendita e sfruttare le opportunità di upselling e cross selling    .  In particolare, ti occuperai di:    Interagire efficacemente con i clienti e garantire gli standard qualitativi attesi, pianificando adeguati e costanti confronti e producendo relativa documentazione;  Presiedere ai meeting di confronto in cui i principali interlocutori saranno costituiti da rete commerciale e System Integrator;  Gestire le interazioni con il team retention e quello di recupero crediti, predisponendo azioni volte a far rientrare le situazioni bloccanti.  Essere il punto di riferimento tecnico e costruire relazioni di fiducia.   Comprendere le necessità del cliente e offrire un supporto tecnico sempre all’altezza delle sfide.   Anticipare i bisogni del cliente, individuando nuove opportunità di business.     Quali competenze cerchiamo?     Esperienza di almeno 3 anni nella gestione di clienti in aziende strutturate;  Gestione di progetti che prevedono scadenze a medio e lungo termine, calcolo di costi finanziari e definizione dell’ottimale mix di risorse da utilizzare per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi prefissati;  Pregressa esperienza e conoscenza del mondo consulenziale;  Rilevante esperienza di guida e governance di Business Processing Outsourcer;  Conoscenza di metodologie di Project Management quale PMP, Prince2, ITIL Expert;  Capacità di sviluppo di soluzioni che supportino le decisioni in sistemi aziendali complessi;  Forte propensione all’utilizzo di strumenti informativi avanzati quali CRM e BI;  Disponibilità a frequenti trasferte sul territorio aziendale di riferimento.    Ti rivedi nelle competenze che cerchiamo? Ottimo inizio! Ma vogliamo anche persone che, grazie al loro  growth mindset , vedano ogni sfida come un'opportuni

title: Customer Excellence Manager Germany
description: At   Bim.com  , we connect the people who build with the products they build with. Are you ready to join this exciting journey as our newest Customer Excellence Manager?   Together with us, you will make a difference – both for our customers and the planet. We offer you the unique opportunity to be part of a small team within a global company of 150 employees. Within the global Customer Excellence team we enjoy working closely together, sharing knowledge and supporting each other in a fast-paced, customer-driven environment. As our new Customer Excellence Manager, you will work hands-on with our customers to support their success on our platform through strong relationships, practical guidance, and close collaboration with internal teams.   In this role you will…     Support and develop a portfolio of customers in the DACH market, building strong, long-term relationships  Act as an advisor for the BIMobject platform, managing customer expectations, experience and value realisation as well as drive adoption and optimal use of the platform’s tools through guidance, insights and follow ups  Co-create customer marketing content such as case studies, campaigns and success stories  Proactively collaborate with Sales, Marketing and Product to ensure customer success  Contribute to building scalable, repeatable ways of working and customer plays that enable us to support customers efficiently at scale  Play a key role in driving customer retention, engagement and long-term value     We believe that you …     Are native in German and fully proficient in English  Communicate confidently and clearly with customers and internal stakeholders  Are structured, solution-oriented and comfortable prioritizing independently  Have a customer-centric mindset, a positive can-do attitude, and enjoy daily interaction with customers while taking ownership of their journey  Enjoy working in a collaborative, international team while owning your responsibilities  Thrive in a technical and data driven environment     Extra awesome (or for you to learn)     Experience in customer success, account management or similar customer-facing roles  Experience working with at-scale customer support and engagement  Experience in or around the construction industry is a plus  Interest or experience in marketing  Speak any additional languages - meritorious with Nordic languages, French, Italian or Spanish     Practicalities   This position is located in Malmö and offers a hybrid work model. We love the mix between meeting at the office, and having the possibility to explore what works best for you.  We know that applying for a job can be intimidating and that applicants rarely meet (or feel that they meet) every single criterion. So, if this role looks like a great next step for you, please apply even if you can’t “check every box.”   More about   Bim.com   The industry is on a journey to build better. To succeed, the people who build need better information about the products they u

title: Customer Experience Manager (15 months contract)
description: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.  The Position   Join us in shaping the future of patient diagnostics and treatment!    Roche Diagnostics Norway is looking for an engaged Customer Experience Manager (15 month temporary position with possibility of extension) .  As Customer Experience Manager, your primary focus will be to ensure an outstanding customer experience. You will be the link between Roche and our partners, and responsible for meeting their expectations and needs throughout the customer journey.  You will play a central role in designing and implementing commercial strategies and activities aimed at pathology laboratories. The product portfolio you will be responsible for includes market-leading diagnostic tests, instruments, and digital solutions. You will be part of an inspiring team in a pleasant and supportive environment, where engaged colleagues want you to succeed.   The Opportunity      Serve as the customer’s main point of contact and act as a trusted ambassador for Roche  Take full ownership of the sales process for assigned laboratories — from identifying opportunities to closing deals  Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with customers, ensuring they perceive Roche as a reliable and value-creating partner  Proactively identify current and future customer needs and translate them into business opportunities  Collaborate closely with internal teams (e.g., service, application, marketing) to deliver optimal solutions and customer satisfaction  Prepare competitive offers, actively participate in tender processes, and manage contract follow-up, including renewals and renegotiations  Plan and implement customer engagement activities in alignment with Roche’s strategies and commercial objectives      Who You Are  We are looking for an engaged, results-oriented, and strategically thinking person with a genuine interest in customer relations and sales.  Qualifications and background:    Education: Higher scientific education (biomedical laboratory scientist, bachelor, master), preferably with experience from laboratory operations. Experience with pathology laboratories is a plus  Experience: Documented results from sales and customer-oriented work, ideally towards the Norwegian healthcare sector  Commercial understanding: Good business acumen and focus on results  Relationship builder: You are a natural relationship builder, thrive in dialogue with people, and are comfortable spending time with customers  Work style: You are proactive, structured, and independent, but also value teamwork

title: Customer Service Manager
description: Customer Services Manager    This position sits at the heart of our growing global organisation, you will be responsible for all aspects of your centre’s performance. We’ll give you the autonomy and resource to manage your centre as though it’s your own business. You will have a wide range of responsibilities including:    Being responsible for managing anything and everything on site.  Rising to every challenge and solving problems.  Giving tours to prospective customers.  Upselling to existing customers.  Above all, looking after our customers so well that each becomes a brand ambassador - for you, your team and IWG.      What We Can Do For You   You’re reading the right advert if you’re looking for:    a fun, challenging and rewarding career.  great induction training and excellent ongoing learning and development.  fantastic promotion prospects.  generous, achievable incentives and sociable hours.  access to a comprehensive range of flexible, personalised workplace benefits that support mental, physical and financial wellbeing.      About You   Ideally, you’ll have some experience of delivering against targets when leading a small, close-knit team. You may have run a flexible workspace centre before, or else a store, restaurant or any site with a high degree of customer focus. Alongside your natural sales and commercial skills, what matters most is that you’ve got the right mindset: passion, drive, ownership and resilience.    Passion: looking after our diverse prospects, customers and guests is at the heart of what we do, so you must bring your passion and positivity to work every day.  Drive: your own and your team’s collective drive for success means you’ll only relax once you’ve delivered the results you’re looking for.  Resilience: a relentless focus on business priorities, regardless of any obstacles placed in front of you.     Above all, you’ll be key to ensuring all our customers only ever receive a truly world-class service.  And your sense of  ownership  means you’ll continuously ensure the quality of service and the workspace are as good as they possibly can be.   About IWG   With almost 4,000 tech-enabled, sustainable and inspiring centres across the world, we’re already four times the scale of our nearest competitor - and we’re continuing to grow.  With 80% of the Fortune 500 already among our customers, and plans to expand to 30,000+ centres over the next decade, we’re uniquely placed to offer the right person exciting career opportunities as we continue pioneering the workspaces of tomorrow.  We know we can only succeed if we give all our people every opportunity to shine. That’s why so many of our most senior leaders started their careers in our centres.  We’re also proud of reducing commuting-related carbon emissions by getting workers out of their cars and onto their bikes and their feet. Alongside our investments in advanced buildings, this supports our commitment to be carbon neutral.  So don’t hesitate. Apply today - a

title: Responsable Equipe Relation Clients H/F
description: Description du poste  Développer vos compétences au sein d'une équipe humaine et dynamique, contribuer à des missions passionnantes permettant de prévenir et de maîtriser les risques, ça vous tente ?   Apave recherche un.e Responsable Equipe Relation Clients en CDI pour piloter les équipes des agences des régions Centre Val de Loire et Champagne Ardennes.   L’équipe relation clientèle assure un rôle majeur : permettre à nos clients d'exercer leur métier en toute sécurité et contribuer ainsi au développement du Groupe Apave au cœur des territoires.   Concrètement, en quoi va consister votre quotidien ?   Après votre parcours d'intégration, vous serez amené à réaliser plusieurs missions :     Encadrer le Service Clients (gestion des appels entrants, traitement des offres commerciales, gestion administrative et facturation, planification des interventions chez les clients)   Organiser les plannings et la répartition des charges de travail, suivre le traitement des travaux administratifs et les délais de réalisation   Management de proximité des équipes (6 conseillers clientèles)   Identification des besoins en compétences des collaborateurs du service clients, former ou mettre en œuvre les formations nécessaires (outils, processus, nouvelles prestations, messages commerciaux,...)   Assurer le suivi opérationnel du traitement des appels clients   Suivre les indicateurs de fonctionnement de votre service, anticiper et traiter les problèmes, assurer un compte-rendu régulier et gérer les arbitrages auprès des différents responsables de service de l'agence.     Choisissez-nous !   En rejoignant Apave, vous intégrez plus qu'un groupe : vous prenez part à une histoire où la force du collectif est une réalité, où la notion d'accompagnement s'exprime au quotidien, pour que chacun trouve naturellement sa place.  Parce que chez Apave, nous considérons nos diﬀérences comme une richesse que nous mettons chaque jour au service de missions à forte utilité sociale.   Nous Rejoindre, C'est      Prendre du plaisir dans le travail et développer votre carrière. description: KPayについて   KPay Group（KPay）は、「シンプル・スマート・シームレス・セキュア」なテクノロジーソリューションを通じて、あらゆる規模のビジネスの成長を支援するフィンテック企業です。  現在、オーストラリア・香港・日本・シンガポールの4市場において、96,000以上の加盟店にサービスを提供しており、決済・業務管理・デジタルトランスフォーメーションを統合したワンストッププラットフォームの提供を推進しています。  2024年には、決済領域におけるシリーズAとして世界最大規模となる5,500万米ドルの資金調達を実施。2025年の「Asia FinTech Awards」におけるPayTech of the Yearの受賞や「Forbes Asia 100 to Watch 2025」への選出に加え、Tech in AsiaおよびStatistaが発表する「Singapore's Top FinTech Companies 2026」にも選出されるなど、アジアを中心に高い評価を獲得しています。      業務内容   ・既存加盟店に対するオンボーディングおよび導入後の活用支援  ・顧客との継続的なコミュニケーションを通じた関係構築・維持  ・サービス利用状況のモニタリングおよび課題抽出  ・顧客満足度向上および解約防止（リテンション施策）の実行  ・顧客フィードバックの収集およびプロダクト改善への連携  ・社内（営業・プロダクト・サポート）との連携による顧客課題の解決  ※主にアウトバウンド（電話・オンライン）でのコミュニケーションが中心となります。      必須スキル・経験   ・マーチャントサクセス／カスタマーサクセス／法人営業いずれかの経験  ・顧客との円滑なコミュニケーション能力  ・主体的（能動的）に行動し、課題解決に取り組める方      歓迎スキル・経験   ・SaaSまたはITサービスに関する業務経験  ・アップセル／クロスセルの実務経験  ・データを活用した顧客分析および改善提案の経験  ・スタートアップまたは成長企業での就業経験      求める人物像   ・受け身ではなく、自ら顧客に働きかけ価値提供ができる方  ・顧客の成功を第一に考え、長期的な関係構築ができる方  ・変化の速い環境に柔軟に対応できる方  ・チームと連携しながら成果を最大化できる方      Why Join KPay?   急成長中のグローバルFinTech企業の成長フェーズに参画できる  経営層や重要顧客との折衝を通じて高いビジネススキルを身につけられる  大きな裁量を持ち、顧客戦略の立案から実行まで一貫して担当できる  プロダクトや事業の成長に直接インパクトを与えることができる  優秀なメンバーとともにスピード感のある環境で挑戦できる      勤務条件    雇用形態   正社員  ※試用期間3ヶ月（待遇変更なし）      勤務時間   午前9時30分～午後6時30分  （コアタイムを午前10時30分～午後4時とするフレックスタイム制あり）  ※土曜日、日曜日、祝日休み      想定年収   450万円      休日・休暇   ・完全週休2日制（土日祝休み）  ・年間休日125日  ・有給休暇  ・病気休暇  ・夏季休暇  ・年末年始休暇  ・誕生日特別休暇      福利厚生   社会保険  ・健康保険  ・厚生年金保険  ・雇用保険  ・労災保険  各種手当  ・交通費支給（実費支給）      Equal Opportunity Employer   ・採用・評価・昇進を含むすべての雇用機会において、公平性を重視しています  ・人種、国籍、宗教、性別、性的指向、性自認、年齢、障がいの有無等による差別を行いません  ・多様なバックグラウンドを持つ人材を歓迎します  ・DE&I（Diversity, Equity & Inclusion）を推進し、誰もが活躍できる環境づくりに取り組んで います

title: Customer Onboarding & Expansion Lead | Top Venture-Backed Auckland FinTech
description: Company Description  Extraordinary is a centralized employee benefits platform that helps employers distribute, manage, and report on meaningful perks with ease. At the core of the platform is the Extraordinary Card, a digital Mastercard that employers fund through flexible modules for corporate gifting, public transport, rewards and recognition, and controllable allowances. These modules enable organizations to deliver tax-efficient commuting support, real-time performance rewards, and targeted wellbeing or work-from-home benefits. The platform is designed to be simple for employers to implement and seamless for employees to use, creating a straightforward way to enhance workplace engagement. Extraordinary focuses on practical, trackable solutions that align benefits spending with company values and employee needs.      Role Description  As the Customer Onboarding & Expansion Lead, you will guide new customers through implementation, from initial discovery and requirements gathering to successful platform launch. You will design and run onboarding plans, configure account settings, coordinate with product and operations teams, and provide training sessions to ensure customers understand and adopt the Extraordinary Card and its modules. Day-to-day, you will monitor customer health, analyze usage trends, and identify opportunities to expand accounts through additional modules, increased adoption, and strategic upsell. You will act as a primary point of contact for key customer stakeholders, manage ongoing support needs, and collaborate with sales and product teams to improve the customer journey. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Auckland, requiring close collaboration with cross-functional teams and in-person engagement with customers as needed.      Qualifications    Strong interpersonal skills and a customer-centric mindset to build trust-based relationships and drive customer satisfaction.  Experience in customer support and account management, with the ability to handle inquiries, resolve issues, and guide customers through onboarding.  Solid analytical skills to interpret customer data, track adoption metrics, and identify expansion opportunities and risks.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills to deliver clear training, documentation, and stakeholder updates.  Background in SaaS, fintech, HR tech, or employee benefits environments is highly beneficial.  Proven experience in customer success, implementation, or onboarding roles, ideally with B2B clients.  Ability to work on-site in Auckland, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and operate autonomously within a fast-paced, venture-backed company.  Bachelor’s degree in business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Account Manager
description: We’re hiring experienced  Account Managers  to own the owner experience throughout the leasing process — the person who keeps the file moving, keeps the client confident, and ensures execution is tight from start to finish.  This role is for someone who already knows how to run a client book: proactive communication, deadline control, clean follow-up, and strong accountability. If you’re organized, fast, and professional under pressure, you’ll do well here.  What You’ll Do    Be the owner’s main point of contact during the leasing process and deliver a “white-glove” client experience  Drive execution across the workflow: confirm readiness, gather missing info, coordinate next steps, and prevent delays  Provide proactive updates so owners always know what’s happening and what comes next  Manage time-sensitive items with urgency and strong communication  Ensure documentation is collected and tracked properly according to company process  Maintain clean CRM records: notes, tasks, follow-ups, and stage movement  Escalate issues early when needed and protect client satisfaction through strong judgment    Requirements (Must-Have)    3–5+ years of account management experience (this is required)  Proven ability to manage multiple clients/files at once with consistent follow-up  Strong communication skills and confidence handling client issues  High process discipline and comfort working in a structured CRM workflow  Calm under pressure and able to prioritize fast in a high-volume environment    Nice-to-Have    Leasing / property management / real estate operations experience  Experience in high-volume, SLA-driven service environments  Comfort using AI/tools to improve documentation, reporting, and internal efficiency    Remote Tech Requirements (Mandatory)    Dual monitor setup  Computer with 16GB RAM minimum  100+ Mbps reliable internet speed  Webcam  Noise-cancelling headset     Compensation     This role offers performance-based compensation with the opportunity to earn approximately $45,000–$50,000+ CAD annually based on performance. Full compensation details will be shared during the interview process.    How to Apply  Apply with your resume. If your background aligns, you’ll receive a link to a short pre-recorded video interview within 24-48 hours after applying.

title: Onboarding & Customer Success Specialist
description: Jet Studio è il prodotto di Jet HR pensato per semplificare la vita ai Consulenti del Lavoro. Tu li aiuterai a sfruttarlo al meglio.   Cosa farai  Il ruolo ha due anime.  Customer Support,  sei il punto di riferimento quotidiano degli studi:   Gestisci ticket e chiamate in arrivo su Zendesk, email e Slack, con l'obiettivo di risolvere problemi o dubbi il prima possibile.  Fai da ponte con prodotto e team tecnico. Raccogli e dai una struttura ai bug segnalati, porti dentro i feedback, segui i ticket perché vengano chiusi.  Costruisci e mantieni l'help center e i materiali di supporto. In modo che le domande ricorrenti si risolvano da sole.    Customer Success,  sei responsabile della vita dello studio con Jet Studio:   Onboarding.  Gestisci il passaggio di consegne dall'Account Executive, il setup della piattaforma e lo scambio documentale. Poi fai formazione allo studio - sessioni 1:1 o in gruppi, in presenza presso lo studio (raramente), oppure su Meet.   Adoption.  Ti assicuri che lo studio usi il prodotto per davvero: calendario presenze, portale azienda cliente, email forwarding, andando oltre le funzionalità base. È il lavoro che più di ogni altro determina se lo studio capisce il potenziale del prodotto.   Retention.  Monitori i segnali di rischio (adozione bassa, ticket ricorrenti, silenzi prolungati) e intervieni prima che diventino un mancato rinnovo.   Upsell.  Individui le opportunità di vendita, incluse quelle verso le aziende clienti dello studio.     Chi cerchiamo   Minimo 2 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di Customer Onboarding, Customer Success o Customer Support, preferibilmente in startup o contesti in rapida crescita.  Capacità di comunicare in modo semplice e strutturato, a voce e per iscritto: davanti a un consulente del lavoro, al collaboratore di studio o all’HR dell’azienda cliente dello studio.  A tuo agio al telefono e in videochiamata: buona parte del lavoro passa da lì, e serve saper ascoltare, cogliere quando qualcosa non è chiaro e riformularlo senza far sentire nessuno in difficoltà.  Attitudine a mettere ordine dove ancora non ce n'è: sei il secondo ingresso nel team, quindi ti troverai spesso a definire tu il processo invece di seguirne uno già scritto. Serve autonomia e la voglia di lasciare le cose meglio di come le hai trovate.     Cosa offriamo    RAL tra €25.000 e €37.000  a seconda dell'esperienza, composta da una parte fissa e una parte variabile legata a obiettivi di adozione, retention e soddisfazione degli studi   Lavoro ibrido.  Abbiamo l’ufficio a Milano. Per 2 giorni a settimana è richiesta la presenza, gli altri 3 flessibile. Senza essere fiscali, operiamo molto a buonsenso e siamo flessibili con gli orari. Due volte l'anno abbiamo un retreat di 3 giorni, tutto pagato da Jet.      Founding member . Sarai il secondo hire del team Customer Support di Jet Studio: il tuo lavoro e le tue idee peseranno da subito, con ampio spazio per crescere di responsabilità.   Impatto concreto . title: Coordinateur/Coordinatrice relation client
description: A propos d'imagino         Créée en 2017, imagino est une société qui développe et commercialise un logiciel à destination des directions Data, Marketing et Digitale des entreprises.     La solution répond aux besoins croissants autour de la donnée client : accès et enrichissement, connaissance client et segmentation, activation et personnalisation, etc.   imagino a été créée par les fondateurs de Neolane  (https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neola ne) qui ont l’ambition de construire et vendre une nouvelle plateforme SaaS de référence mondiale.  Suite à une levée de fonds réussie de 25 millions d'euros en juin 2024, imagino, déjà présente en France et au Royaume-Uni, accélère son développement mondial en ouvrant un bureau aux États-Unis afin de renforcer encore sa croissance et sa présence sur le marché      Description du poste      Au sein de l’équipe Relation Client d’imagino, vous serez en charge de l’animation de notre base clients installée et du bon déroulement de l’onboarding.  Votre mission principale est de développer une relation proactive avec les clients afin de garantir leur adoption de la plateforme, d'en maximiser l’usage et la valeur, et de renforcer leur engagement sur le long terme.  Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la satisfaction client, en assurant un suivi régulier, en accompagnant la montée en compétence des utilisateurs, et en identifiant les leviers d’activation de nouveaux cas d’usage.  Ce rôle est transverse : vous travaillerez en interaction quotidienne avec les équipes Produit, R&D, Consulting, Support, Sales et Opérations, afin d’aligner les actions, remonter les besoins clients, résoudre les irritants et faire progresser l’expérience utilisateur.      Missions principales :       Assurer un suivi régulier et structuré des clients via des points d’étape (revue trimestrielle, rendez-vous de suivi...)  Présenter la roadmap produit, les évolutions récentes et les cas d’usage pertinents pour nourrir la réflexion des clients  Analyser les usages et KPIs de la plateforme côté client pour détecter les signaux faibles, les axes d’optimisation ou les zones de friction  Recueillir les besoins, attentes et irritants du client, et piloter leur résolution en s’appuyant sur les bons interlocuteurs internes ou partenaires (consultants, formateur, partenaires, support…)  Piloter l’adoption globale de la solution : vous identifiez les leviers, priorisez les actions et coordonnez les ressources pour favoriser l’appropriation  Identifier les risques de churn ou de sous-utilisation, et mettre en œuvre les actions adaptées  Repérer les opportunités de développement et/ou d’upsell  Faire remonter et partager en interne les retours clients pour enrichir la roadmap et l’orientation des développements  Identifier les clients susceptibles de participer à des actions marketing, telles que des témoignages, partages de cas d’usage, interventions lors de webinars, petits déjeuners ou autres événements de la communauté client, en lien avec les éq

title: Senior Customer Relationship Management Consultant
description: Location: Remote across Europe, with the option to work from our offices in Finland or Stockholm.      Hey Klaviyo expert! 👋 If you know Klaviyo inside out and want to become the person others turn to when the question is  “How should this actually work?”  – while helping shape and grow Woolman’s CRM capability around complex ecommerce clients – this could be your next challenge.      Key points about the role at a glance   ✅  Own Klaviyo expertise at Woolman  – become the go-to person for how the platform works and how clients can get more value from it.  ✅ Own CRM work end-to-end across complex ecommerce migration projects and continuous-service clients.  ✅ Solve real Klaviyo challenges across customer data, segmentation, lifecycle automation, migrations and deliverability.  ✅ Help build Woolman’s Klaviyo capability by guiding the wider team, strengthening our Klaviyo partnership and shaping repeatable services.  ✅ Join a flat, trust-based international team with real autonomy and room to influence.  ✅  Salary:  Starting from €5,000/month, depending on experience and location. For a strong Klaviyo expert, we’re open to discussing a salary level that reflects your experience and the value you’d bring to the role.      Why Klaviyo matters at Woolman      Woolman's mission is simple:  help ecommerce brands run and grow on Shopify – and make better use of the customer data and technology around it.      CRM – and particularly Klaviyo – has become an increasingly important part of that work. Our Shopify projects are getting larger and more complex, and around 80% of the Shopify Plus clients we work with use Klaviyo.     We’ve made a clear strategic choice to develop this capability further:  Klaviyo is one of Woolman’s most important technology partners alongside Shopify.      We already see strong commercial potential around Klaviyo, both within existing clients and through new ecommerce projects. Our goal is to deepen our expertise, serve more clients and turn recurring needs into clearer, scalable services.     That’s where you come in.     You won’t be one Klaviyo consultant among twenty. You’ll be one of the people  owning and shaping this expertise at Woolman  – solving demanding client cases, helping colleagues navigate Klaviyo questions and influencing how our services develop.     As the business grows, this role can become a key senior position in a broader Klaviyo/CRM capability.      What you'll do as our Senior CRM Consultant      You’ll be the  go-to Klaviyo expert  across Woolman’s client work.     This is primarily a  hands-on, client-facing role . You’ll combine deep product knowledge with an understanding of ecommerce and customer behaviour to determine what clients need, what Klaviyo can actually do and what the best solution looks like in practice.     Our clients are typically mid-sized and larger retail and consumer brands. You’ll usually work across a couple of substantial projects alongside ongoing client relationships.

description: Customer Success Team Leader, Enterprise    Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates    Team: Enterprise Customer Success Team Leader    Reports to: Director of Enterprise    Contract: Full time, permanent    About Property Finder    Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa. Founded in Dubai in 2007, we connect home seekers with the agents and developers who serve them, and we build the tools the region's property industry runs on. Our Enterprise clients are the largest brokerages and developers in the UAE, and the quality of their experience with us is a commercial priority, not an afterthought.    The role    We are looking for a Customer Team Leader to lead our Enterprise Customer Success Partner team in Dubai. Enterprise covers our highest value accounts, where a single relationship can be worth millions of dirhams a year and where service quality is a direct driver of renewal. You will lead a team of 12 Customer Success Partners who work alongside our Business Consultants, and you will own the standard of service those clients receive every day. Proven people leadership at scale, ideally a team of eight or more, with examples of individuals you have developed.  A track record in customer success, account management or client servicing within a commercial, target-carrying environment.  Comfort with data and systems. title: Director, Customer Success
description: At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.  So, what’s the role all about?  We are looking for an exceptional Customer Success leader to lead and elevate a global team of approximately 26 Customer Success Managers across Australia, the US, UK, Germany and the wider EMEA region.  This is a senior leadership role for someone who knows what great Customer Success looks like and has the experience, credibility and energy to build it at scale. You will set the global Customer Success strategy, establish a clear and scalable operating model, raise standards across regions and develop our CSMs into consistently stronger strategic customer leaders. Instead, you will operate as a strategic leader, coach and expert across the Customer Success organisation, providing direction, challenge and expertise across Customer Success strategy, methodology, processes, commercial discipline, customer value and team performance.  You will bring consistency to a geographically distributed organisation while recognising that different markets and customers require different approaches. You will challenge existing thinking, raise the bar and create an environment where CSMs are accountable for delivering measurable customer and business outcomes.  Working closely with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Support, Engineering and senior leadership, you will play a critical role in ensuring Customer Success is positioned as a strategic function and a key driver of customer value, retention and growth.  How will you make an impact?    Lead, coach and develop a global team of approximately 26 Customer Success Managers across Australia, the US, UK, Germany and the wider EMEA region, creating a high performance, accountable and collaborative culture.   Set the global Customer Success strategy and translate it into clear priorities, standards and measurable outcomes that can be consistently understood and executed across regions.   Own and continuously evolve the global Customer Success methodology, operating model, processes, governance, tooling and best practices, ensuring they remain effective as the organisation scales.   Establish a consistent framework for customer planning, onboarding, adoption, value realisation, customer health, risk identification, renewals and expansion, working closely with Sales to ensure clear ownership and collaboration.   Coach CSMs to become stronger strategic customer leaders, developing their capabilities across executive engagement, commercial acumen, value selling, stakeholder management, strategic account planning and effective customer conversations.   Provide constructive challenge

Run the full onboarding process end to end: partner registration in the CRM, KYC and due diligence documents, agreement execution, MT5 group and rebate assignment, referral link setup and portal walkthrough.   Present and explain the Milele Prime rebate ladder, sub IB structure, payout terms and anti abuse rules clearly and accurately, and escalate custom rate requests with a volume justification.   Activate onboarded partners: agree a launch plan with each IB, supply marketing materials and landing pages, track first client registrations and first deposits, and intervene where a partner stalls. Handle partner queries on commissions, payouts, client attribution and portal access, coordinating with finance, dealing and the CRM tech team for resolution.   Maintain an accurate partner pipeline in the CRM with stage, expected volume, contact history and next action for every prospect and active partner.   Flag suspected abuse, self referral, bonus arbitrage or client poaching to compliance and the dealing desk.   Represent Milele Prime at industry expos and partner events in the UAE and target markets as required.     Requirements      Minimum 3 years in an IB, partnerships or affiliate role at a retail forex or CFD brokerage, with a personal track record of onboarding IBs. Candidates must be able to state the number of IBs they onboarded and the volume those IBs produced.   Working knowledge of MetaTrader 5, broker CRMs and partner portals, rebate models (per lot, per volume, revenue share) and multi level IB structures.   Existing network of IBs, signal providers or trading communities in at least one of South Asia, Africa or MEN

title: Director, Customer Success, EMEA
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.  The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.    Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.    Position overview  GitLab is looking for a strategic, commercially minded, and operationally rigorous Director of Customer Success to lead our EMEA Customer Success Management & Architecture (CSMA) and Customer Success Engineering (CSE) organizations.  This leader will own the regional customer-success operating model across relationship management, adoption architecture, technical enablement, customer health, and outcome realization. The role brings together the strengths of CSMA and CSE so customers can move from implementation to adoption, measurable business outcomes, expansion, and renewal with a consistent experience.  You will lead through managers and senior leaders, build a high-performing all-remote organization, and partner closely with Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success Operations.  What you will do  Set the regional customer-success strategy    Translate GitLab’s customer-outcomes strategy into a clear EMEA plan for CSMA and CSE. Establish a single view of the customer journey, from onboarding and implementation through adoption, optimization, expansion, and renewal.  Ensure the organization consistently connects GitLab adoption to customer-defined business outcomes—not activity, features, or meetings alone.  Represent EMEA customer needs and patterns in global Customer Success strategy and planning.    Lead CSMA and CSE as one integrated organization

title: Customer Success Consultant
description: Customer Success Consultant   Word onderdeel van dé disruptor binnen PropTech. Je stapt in aan het einde van hun meest succesvolle jaar tot nu toe: één van de grootste onafhankelijke vastgoedbeheerders van Nederland, met meer dan 35.000 real estate properties in beheer, koos het platform als dé tech hub voor compliance en onderhoud over hun hele residentiële portefeuille.      Waar draait deze rol om?   Dit is je kans om van hospitality naar tech over te stappen zonder je servicegerichtheid in te ruilen voor targets. Geen omzetverantwoordelijkheid, wel alle impact van iemand die ervoor zorgt dat klanten daadwerkelijk waarde uit hun software halen.  Jij bent het gezicht voor vastgoedbeheerders die net zijn aangesloten en hun eerste gebouwdocumenten, certificaten en processen moeten onboarden. Waar zij vroeger tijd verloren aan losse mailtjes en zoekgeraakte documenten, zorg jij dat ze vanaf dag één overzicht en controle hebben.  Deze rol past bij iemand die energie krijgt van een klant die na jouw training zelfstandig verder kan, en die net zo lang doorvraagt tot een probleem écht is opgelost.      Jouw impact   Iedere vastgoedbeheerder die je succesvol onboardt, is een klant die blijft, meer gebruikt en het platform aanbeveelt. Je verzorgt trainingen en supportsessies, helpt mee aan opgenomen webinars als laagdrempelige kennisbron, en signaleert patronen in wat klanten lastig vinden — en pakt dat zelf op. Je bouwt duurzame relaties op met sleutelklanten en -partners in een markt die nog volop aan het digitaliseren is.      Het team waar je deel van uitmaakt   Je maakt onderdeel uit van het internationale customer success team, maar bedient de Nederlandse markt. Je werkt nauw samen met product en sales, zodat wat klanten nodig hebben ook echt landt in het platform.      Hoe je je ontwikkelt    Je leert een compleet nieuwe sector kennen: vastgoedbeheer, compliance en governance, vanuit de voorhoede van de digitalisering ervan.  Je bouwt ervaring op in SaaS customer success, waar jouw klantfeedback direct invloed heeft op het product.  Je werkt in een snelgroeiende, internationale scale-up waar rollen meegroeien met het bedrijf.       Wat je meebrengt    Een achtergrond in hospitality, customer success of een andere servicegerichte rol.  Je bent organisatorisch sterk, proactief en haalt voldoening uit klanten écht verder helpen.  Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.  Je hebt zin om te werken in een snelgroeiende, internationale scale-up.       Wat je ervoor terugkrijgt    Een salaris tussen €3.500 en €4.500 bruto per maand, excl. 8% vakantiegeld.  De kickstart van een SaaS-carrière, zonder dat je meteen commerciële targets aan je broek krijgt.  Pensioenregeling van 3% via Brand New Day.  Werken in een jong, ambitieus en internationaal team.  Groeikansen naar Customer Success Manager en senior posities.  Hybride set-up, laptop van de zaak en een e-sim zodat je je eigen telefoon kunt behouden.

title: Ansvarlig for drift og rådgivning af leasingpartnere
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Hos Clever gør vi os umage for at være den foretrukne samarbejdspartner på markedet, og derfor leder vi efter en ny kollega, der har lyst til at hjælpe og rådgive vores leasingpartnere.   Din rolle   Du er med til at sikre, at vores leasingpartnere oplever Clever som en professionel, nærværende og løsningsorienteret samarbejdspartner. Der er mange aktører på markedet, og derfor er din rolle med at hjælpe og rådgive vores relationer vigtig i vores daglige arbejde.  Du skaber forbindelse mellem vores leasingpartnere og Clever, når du hjælper med alt fra daglig rådgivning til onboarding, oplæring og udvikling af samarbejdet. Nogle arbejdsopgaver er en del af den faste drift, mens andre opstår spontant og kræver, at du kan skabe overblik og finde løsninger sammen med kollegaer på tværs af organisationen. Du får medansvar for at drive udvalgte leasingpartnere og en hverdag med relationer, drift og udvikling.  En del af rollen er også at besøge leasingpartnere, gennemføre onboarding og deltage i relevante arrangementer. Derfor er kørekort en forudsætning for at lykkes i rollen.  Hos os har vi ikke klassiske titler. Vi har profiler. Når vi kalder rollen "leasingkonsulent", er det, så du og resten af verden ved, hvem vi leder efter. Men når du starter hos os, bliver din profil "Ansvarlig for drift og rådgivning af leasingpartnere" – for det er netop det, du er.   Din hverdag   Rollen består primært af drift og sagsbehandling. Derudover er der også arbejdsopgaver, der kredser om relationsopbygning og udvikling af samarbejdet med leasingpartnere. Din hverdag vil blandt andet være fyldt med:     Rådgivning af leasingpartnere på telefon og mail om vores produkter, processer og løsninger    Håndtering af sagsbehandling i Dynamics    Styrke relationen til leasingpartnere bl.a. ved at besøge dem    Guide og hjælpe vores leasingpartnere i vores partnerportal       Hvem er du?   Når vi drømmer om vores nye kollega, ser vi dig, der:     Får energi af at skabe og vedligeholde stærke relationer    Arbejder struktureret, selvstændigt og løsningsorienteret    Kan forstå og formidle komplekse produkter og løsninger på en enkel måde      Vi bliver ekstra begejstrede, hvis du:     Har erfaring fra opladnings-, energi- eller leasingbranchen    Har arbejdet med CRM-systemer, gerne Dynamics       Dit team   Du bliver en del af team Erhvervsleasing, som består af 10 kollegaer. Der er otte kollegaer, som arbejder med drift og rådgivning af leasingpartnere, mens to arbejder med partnerskaber og forretningsudvikling. Selvom vi har forskellige ansvarsområder, hjælper vi hinanden på tværs.  I hverdagen holder vi af at være sammen på kontoret, når vi ikke er på besøg hos vores partnere. Vi håber også, at du har lyst til at være med, når vi samles om en fælles aktivitet eller et glas vin efter arbejde. Kort sagt værdsætter vi relationerne til hinanden mindst lige så højt som relationerne til vores partnere.   Medledelseskompetencer - vi er nemlig organiseret anderledes

title: HR Operations Manager
description: We are looking for an experienced  HR Operations Manager  to oversee the day-to-day HR operations and ensure their efficient and effective execution. The role will be responsible for implementing approved HR policies and procedures, improving the quality and flow of HR operations, ensuring timely completion of tasks, and supporting the achievement of the company's overall HR objectives. Update the internal regulations in compliance with the regulations of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD). Perform other HR operations-related tasks or projects as assigned by senior management or the Head of Human Resources. title: Senior SAP Project Manager
description: Do you enjoy leading SAP projects of different sizes and complexity? We do.   We’re looking for a  Senior SAP Project Manager  to join Vincit and take ownership of SAP projects of varying size and complexity, from more focused deliveries to larger business transformations.  In this role, you’ll be responsible for making sure projects move forward smoothly, while working closely with customers and expert teams to balance delivery, scope, and business goals.  You know you’ve succeeded when projects are delivered as planned, stakeholders are aligned, and the work creates real value for the customer – whether it’s through a smaller improvement or a larger transformation.   What is the job like, really?   Our SAP customer portfolio is broad and diverse, and the work varies from more focused implementations to larger transformation initiatives. You’ll work in both multi-vendor environments and projects where Vincit takes full delivery responsibility.   Here’s a Snapshot Of Your Key Responsibilities    ☘️ Leading SAP projects end-to-end:  You take ownership of delivery, ensuring projects stay on track in terms of scope, timeline, and quality.   ☘️ Owning financials and scope:  You take responsibility for project profitability, budgeting, and scope management.   ☘️ Driving business transformation:  You don’t just deliver systems, you help customers implement real business changes through SAP.   ☘️ Leading teams and stakeholders:  You lead cross-functional teams and work closely with stakeholders to ensure alignment and success.   ☘️ Supporting sales and pre-sales:  You act as an expert in sales cases, helping shape solutions and identify new opportunities.   What are we looking for?   You’ll succeed in this role if you’re able to see the bigger picture and take ownership not only of delivery but also of business outcomes.  You’re comfortable leading complex projects where expectations are high and things don’t always go as planned. You take responsibility for financials, scope, and team performance – and know how to balance all three.   Your background   🎯 Experience leading SAP projects, including large-scale business transformations  🎯 Experience delivering complex SAP solutions (e.g. S/4HANA)  🎯 Experience managing project financials, profitability, and scope  🎯 Ability to lead teams and stakeholders in demanding environments  🎯 Understanding of business processes and ability to identify new opportunities  🎯 Working proficiency in Finnish and English   It’s a Strong Plus If You Have   🎯 Experience in manufacturing or other industry domains  🎯 Experience with both core ERP and cloud-based SAP solutions  🎯 Project management certifications  🎯 Experience working in consultancy environments  🎯 Experience supporting sales or pre-sales activities  What’s in it for you? description: ERP-projektijohtamisen ammattilainen – liity SCK Consultingin asiantuntijatiimiin!       Etsimme kokenutta ERP-projektijohtamisen asiantuntijaa  vahvistamaan kasvavaa tiimiämme.  SCK Consulting auttaa asiakkaitaan johtamaan muutosta, kehittämään liiketoimintaa ja viemään vaativia uudistus- ja järjestelmähankkeita onnistuneesti maaliin. Nyt etsimme joukkoomme ammattilaista, jolla on vahvaa kokemusta ERP-hankkeista ja kykyä johtaa kokonaisuuksia liiketoiminnan tavoitteista onnistuneeseen käyttöönottoon asti.     Asiakasprojektimme voivat olla esimerkiksi ERP-uudistuksia, käyttöönottoprojekteja, järjestelmä- ja prosessikehitystä tai laajempia liiketoiminnan transformaatiohankkeita.      Voisit olla etsimämme asiantuntija, jos sinulla on:    vahvaa kokemusta ERP-projekteista ja niiden johtamisesta  noin 10 vuoden kokemus vaativista projekti-, ohjelma- tai kehittämistehtävistä  ymmärrystä ERP-hankkeiden eri vaiheista, kuten määrittelystä, suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta, testauksesta, käyttöönotosta ja muutoksen läpiviennistä  kykyä hallita laajoja kokonaisuuksia, aikatauluja, tavoitteita, riippuvuuksia, riskejä ja sidosryhmiä  kokemusta työskentelystä asiakkaiden, liiketoiminnan, IT ja järjestelmätoimittajien kanssa  hyvät vuorovaikutus-, fasilitointi- ja yhteistyötaidot  itsenäinen, vastuullinen ja järjestelmällinen työote.      Arvostamme lisäksi kokemusta ERP-järjestelmistä ja -ympäristöistä, kuten SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle, IFS tai vastaavista, sekä ketteristä ja hybridimallisista projektimenetelmistä.  Taustasi voi olla esimerkiksi  ERP Project Managerin, Program Managerin, ERP Leadin, Senior Project Managerin tai muun vaativan ERP- ja muutoshankkeiden johtamisroolin  parista.      Mitä pääset tekemään?       Tehtäväsi rakentuvat osaamisesi, kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi ympärille. Voit päästä esimerkiksi:    johtamaan ERP-uudistuksia ja käyttöönottoprojekteja  toimimaan asiakkaan edustajana ja koordinoimaan liiketoiminnan, IT ja järjestelmätoimittajien yhteistyötä  johtamaan monialaisia tiimejä ja sidosryhmiä  kehittämään asiakkaiden prosesseja, toimintamalleja ja liiketoimintaa  tukemaan organisaatioita muutoksissa ja järjestelmäuudistuksissa  hallitsemaan projektien aikatauluja, riippuvuuksia, riskejä ja päätöksentekoa  varmistamaan, että suunnitelmat muuttuvat konkreettisiksi tuloksiksi.       Miksi SCK Consulting?    Palkkaus:  Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen kuukausipalkan, joka määräytyy roolin, kokemuksesi sekä toimeksiannon vaativuuden ja laajuuden perusteella.   Vaikutusmahdollisuudet:  Meillä asiantuntijan näkemyksellä on merkitystä. Pääset vaikuttamaan omaan rooliisi, asiakasprojekteihin ja yrityksemme kehittämiseen.   Monipuoliset asiakasprojektit:  Pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi erilaisissa ERP-, muutos- ja kehityshankkeissa eri organisaatioissa ja toimialoilla.   Kokenut ja mutkaton työyhteisö:  Teemme töitä ammattimaisesti ilman turhaa jäykkyyttä. Sparraamme toisiamme ja jaamme osaamista aktiivisesti.   Joustava työympäri

title: Digital Quality System Lead and Digital Quality System Manager
description: Job Description    Drive the development of reliable, user-friendly and compliant digital quality systems   At Orion Pharma, our mission is to build well-being through innovative medicines and solutions. We are now looking for two professionals for our new Digital Quality System team: a  Digital Quality System Lead , who will act as the team’s people manager, and a  Digital Quality System Manager , who will work as a specialist in the team. Both positions combine ownership with active hands-on contribution to the development, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of digital systems and tools used in Quality Management.  These are full-time positions based in Espoo or Turku, Finland. Orion supports a hybrid working model, with employees working onsite three days per week and remotely for up to two days per week.   Your role   In both roles, you will manage and develop digital quality system capabilities in close collaboration with Quality Management, Information Management, system owners, process owners and external partners. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that our digital quality systems are reliable, user-friendly, compliant and aligned with evolving business and regulatory needs. You will translate quality management priorities and process needs into practical system improvements, drive the implementation of enhancements and help build more efficient, digitally supported and increasingly automated ways of working across Quality Management, including the appropriate use of AI-enabled solutions. The Lead will additionally provide people leadership, set the team’s direction and priorities, and establish effective ways of working. title: Führungskraft (m/w/d) Eingliederungshilfe & Soziale Teilhabe
description:
Der Caritasverband Rheine e. V. sucht eine Leitung (m/w/d) der Abteilung "Arbeit, Wohnen und Teilhabe", unbefristet in Vollzeit.

Die Caritas Rheine setzt sich als einer der größten Arbeitgeber der Region mit rund 50 sozialen Einrichtungen und Diensten für Menschen ein, die Unterstützung benötigen. Das umfangreiche Angebotsportfolio des Komplexträgers erstreckt sich über die Bereiche Familie, Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Gefährdeten- und Eingliederungshilfe, Hilfe für suchterkrankte sowie psychisch kranke Menschen, ambulante und stationäre Pflege sowie Migration und Integration. Insgesamt stehen rund 1.800 hauptamtliche Mitarbeitende sowie etwa 500 ehrenamtlich Engagierte den Menschen mit ihren individuellen Bedürfnissen zur Seite.

Die Abteilung Arbeit, Wohnen und Teilhabe des Caritasverbandes Rheine e. V. begleitet Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Unterstützungs- oder Beratungsbedarfen. Menschen mit Behinderungen oder psychischen Erkrankungen befähigen wir, ihr Leben selbstbestimmt zu gestalten und aktiv am gesellschaftlichen Leben teilzuhaben. Mit den Caritas-Emstor-Werkstätten werden vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Teilhabe, Qualifizierung und persönlichen Entwicklung geschaffen. Im Jacob-Meyersohn-Wohnverbund unterstützen wir Menschen mit Behinderungen durch ambulante Angebote sowie in verschiedenen Wohnformen. title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Berlin
description:
Deine Mission

Du übernimmst die volle strategische und operative Verantwortung für unser Performance Marketing mit Fokus auf Meta und Google. Du entwickelst zusammen mit der Head of Marketing die Kanalstrategie, planst und verantwortest das Budget und sorgst für eine kontinuierliche Skalierung bei stabiler oder wachsender Effizienz.

Du arbeitest eng mit der Head of Marketing sowie Content/Design zusammen.

Diese Stelle entsteht im Zuge unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase, in der wir unser Marketing-Team ausbauen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Performance-Marketing-Strategie für Meta und Google eigenverantwortlich entwickeln, inklusive Budget-Forecasting und Kanal-Mix-Entscheidungen
  • Meta-Ads-Kampagnen eigenständig aufsetzen, skalieren und optimieren (Paid Facebook, Paid Instagram, Advantage+) inkl. strukturiertem Creative Testing auf Basis klarer Hypothesen
  • Google-Ads-Kampagnen über Performance Max, Search und GDN strategisch planen, skalieren und laufend optimieren (Smart-Bidding-Strategien, Asset-Gruppen, Audience Signals)
  • Ein systematisches Testing- und Measurement-Framework aufbauen, inklusive Incrementality Testing und sauberer Attribution über alle Kanäle hinweg

  • Landingpages gemeinsam mit Content/Design kontinuierlich testen und auf Conversion optimieren
  • Unsere Tool-Landschaft (Pipedrive, Make, HeyFlow) mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln (von der Lead-Übergabe bis zur Automatisierung wiederkehrender Prozesse)
  • SEA-Maßnahmen eigenständig verantworten und SEO-Grundlagen im Blick behalten
  • Marketing-KPIs und Unit Economics (CTR, ROAS, CPL, MQL, Conversion Rate, Qualifikationsrate, CAC, LTV) laufend auswerten, forecasten und in Budget-Entscheidungen übersetzen

Du gibst den Editoren fundiertes Feedback und schneidest bei Bedarf selbst.

title: Customer Success Manager Legal AI
description: Lefebvre Sdu is misschien wel de oudste AI-startup van Nederland. Niet omdat we voorop lopen in technologie, maar omdat we de kennis hebben waar die technologie op draait. Die bouwen we al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat is niet te kopiëren. Als Nederlands hart van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, bouwen we GenIA-L: een AI-platform waarop juristen en fiscalisten niet zomaar een antwoord krijgen, maar een antwoord waar ze hun naam onder durven te zetten. Meer dan 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, goed voor ruim 100 miljoen euro ARR in Europa. We zoeken iemand die zorgt dat ze het ook echt anders gaan doen.      HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT   Een licentie afsluiten is één ding. Een kantoor zijn werkproces laten herzien rond AI is iets anders. Juristen en fiscalisten werken zoals ze werken omdat het al jaren zo gaat, en een nieuw platform verandert daar uit zichzelf niets aan. Iemand moet naast ze gaan zitten, kijken hoe hun dossierwerk er nu uitziet en laten zien waar GenIA-L dat werk overneemt of versnelt. Daarvoor moet je dat werk zelf hebben gedaan. Jij hebt jaren in de praktijk gestaan. Je weet hoe een dossier wordt opgebouwd, waar de uren in gaan zitten en waarom een professional niet zomaar vertrouwt op een antwoord dat hij niet kan narekenen. Die geloofwaardigheid is je belangrijkste instrument: wanneer jij tegenover een partner zit, praat je met iemand uit hetzelfde vak. Je bent daarmee de belangrijkste ambassadeur van het product, naar buiten én naar binnen. Wat jij bij klanten ziet, breng je terug, want de beste roadmap-input komt van mensen die het platform elke dag proberen te gebruiken.      Je begeleidt klanten van livegang tot volwassen gebruik, en je stuurt op adoptie in plaats van op tevredenheid.  Je analyseert de werkprocessen van juridische en fiscale teams en vertaalt die naar een concrete inrichting van GenIA-L.  Je traint gebruikers en interne key users, zodat kennis over het platform bij de klant blijft.  Je meet gebruik, signaleert waar adoptie stokt en grijpt in voordat een verlenging in gevaar komt.  Je bouwt aan een aanpak die herhaalbaar is: playbooks, use cases en voorbeelden die je bij de volgende klant weer inzet.  Je brengt de praktijk van de klant terug naar product en redactie, en je bent de stem van de gebruiker in onze eigen ontwikkeling.  Je werkt nauw samen met sales, zodat uitbreiding en verlenging voortkomen uit gebruik dat aantoonbaar waarde oplevert.       DIT ZOEKEN WIJ   Je bent commercieel sterk en op het punt gekomen waarop je meer wilt dan alleen verkopen. Je hebt gezien wat AI met de manier waarop organisaties werken gaat doen en je wilt aan die kant van de tafel zitten, bij de partij die het bouwt in plaats van bij de partij die het over zich heen krijgt. Je commerciële ervaring neem je mee, maar je wilt dichter op de klant, het product en de impact zitten.   Ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol in customer success, business

Dan is de rol van  Service Delivery Manager bij Portbase  iets voor jou!      Wat ga je doen?   Als Service Delivery Manager binnen het Platform Cluster & PCS zorg je ervoor dat onze platformservices betrouwbaar, voorspelbaar en goed georganiseerd worden geleverd. Je vormt de verbindende schakel tussen platformteams, serviceteams, operations, architectuur, security en management.     Je kijkt daarbij verder dan processen en procedures. Het gaat je om het resultaat: een stabiele dienstverlening, snelle en effectieve incidentafhandeling, kwalitatieve changes en continue verbetering.     Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:   Regie voeren op de service delivery van platformservices zoals cloud infrastructure, networking, IAM, messaging, API gateway management en development services;  Verder ontwikkelen en implementeren van ITSM-practices rondom incident-, change-, problem-, request- en service level management;  Verbeteringen initiëren en realiseren op basis van data, feedback en behoeften vanuit teams en stakeholders;  Ontwikkelen van service dashboards, rapportages, runbooks en andere middelen die bijdragen aan betere operationele dienstverlening;  Verbinden van technische teams, security, architectuur, operations en management en zorgen voor duidelijke afspraken, rollen en escalatieroutes;  Zorgen voor structurele opvolging van incidenten, verbeteracties en terugkerende verstoringen;  Werken vanuit een productmatige mindset: behoeften ophalen, prioriteiten bepalen en interne services steeds verder ontwikkelen. Vanuit het cluster werken verschillende teams aan de platform capabilities waarop de logistieke workflowteams van Portbase bouwen. De betrouwbaarheid van deze services is essentieel voor de continuïteit van de digitale havenlogistiek.     De komende jaren ligt er een belangrijke opgave om de operationele dienstverlening verder te professionaliseren. ITSM, service governance, observability, rapportages en continue verbetering krijgen daarbij steeds meer vorm.     Als Service Delivery Manager speel je hierin een sleutelrol. Je krijgt de ruimte om niet alleen bestaande processen te beheren, maar juist mee te bouwen aan de manier waarop we onze interne dienstverlening organiseren.     Je week bestaat uit een mix

title: Service Delivery Manager
description: About Maersk E-Commerce   At Maersk, we are on a journey to become the global integrator of container logistics, delivering end-to-end supply chain solutions that connect businesses with opportunities around the world. By integrating ocean, air, land transportation, warehousing, fulfilment, and digital services, we help customers navigate an increasingly complex supply chain landscape. Within Maersk E-Commerce, we support some of the world's fastest-growing brands with scalable fulfilment, delivery, returns, and customer experience solutions, enabling merchants to grow seamlessly across European and global markets.   The Opportunity   We are looking for a customer-centric and commercially minded Service Delivery Manager to lead Service Delivery across Europe.  This is a strategic leadership role that combines customer advocacy, operational excellence, commercial ownership, and transformation. You will act as the voice of the customer, building strong relationships with key accounts, leading complex escalations, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders to ensure customer needs are translated into meaningful actions and measurable business outcomes.  You will play a critical role in driving customer retention, protecting revenue, and identifying opportunities to enable account growth across our European customer portfolio.  At the same time, you will be responsible for continuously improving and scaling our Service Delivery operation through automation, AI, self-service capabilities, and process optimisation. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences while building the operating model of the future.  Key Responsibilities    Act as the primary advocate for customers across the European business.  Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic customers, ensuring a deep understanding of their goals, challenges, and growth plans.  Lead critical customer escalations and service recovery activities, driving timely and effective resolution.  Partner with commercial, product, operations, and technology teams to improve the customer experience and service performance.  Drive customer retention and revenue protection initiatives.  Identify opportunities to support account expansion and long-term customer growth.  Lead operational excellence initiatives focused on productivity, scalability, and cost-to-serve improvements.  Reduce WISMO ("Where Is My Order?") demand through proactive communication, self-service tools, and digital customer journeys.  Champion the adoption of AI, automation, and digital solutions to improve customer and operational outcomes.  Develop a scalable Service Delivery model capable of supporting continued business growth across Europe.  Use data and insights to identify trends, measure performance, and drive continuous improvement.    What We're Looking For    Leadership experience within Service Delivery, Customer Operations, Customer Success, or a similar custome
